ops.current: １日は (the first day) is the subject marked by は
ops.fix: １日は (the first day) is the topic marked by は
ops.full_before: Simple nominal sentence in the polite register: topic plus predicate. １日は (the first day) is the subject marked by は, and 休みです (is a day off) is the predicate, formed by the noun 休み (rest/day off) plus the polite copula です. ついたち is the special reading of 1日 (the first day of the month).
ops.issue: Calls １日は the 'subject marked by は'; は marks the topic. Inconsistent with the same sentence's opening ('topic plus predicate'), with expl_pt ('assunto'), and with the token role 'tópico'.

ops.current: このべいわとてもおいしい
ops.fix: このこめわとてもおいしい

ops.current: konobeiwatotemooishii
ops.fix: konokomewatotemooishii
ops.issue: Romaji propagates the wrong reading 'bei' for 米; should reflect こめ (kome).

ops.current: べい
ops.fix: こめ
ops.issue: Reading of 米 in this sentence is こめ (standalone noun 'rice'); べい is the compound-only on'yomi and is wrong in context. Explanation fields correctly say こめ.

ops.current: vira o sujeito de quem se gosta, marcado por が
ops.fix: vira o sujeito do que se gosta, marcado por が
ops.full_before: A frase usa o padrão 〜のがすきです, que serve para dizer que se gosta de FAZER alguma coisa. O verbo 読む (ler) é transformado em substantivo pela partícula nominalizadora の, e essa ação inteira (本を読む = ler livros) vira o sujeito de quem se gosta, marcado por が. No fim, すきです (gostar) é um 形状詞 (adjetivo-na) que descreve a preferência. O tópico わたしは indica de quem é o gosto.
ops.issue: 'de quem se gosta' uses 'quem' (for people) although the referent is the action 本を読む; the English version says 'the subject of what is liked'. Should be 'do que se gosta'.

ops.current: com frequência, bastante (quite often, a lot)
ops.fix: com frequência, bastante
ops.issue: English text leaked into the Portuguese gloss of よく: '(quite often, a lot)'. The same word is glossed cleanly in other sentences (e.g. 'frequentemente, bastante').

ops.current: Recentemente, quanto ao trabalho, (ele) aumentou e (estou) ocupado.

ops.current: どあがひらく

ops.current: A porta abre-se.
ops.fix: A porta se abre.

ops.current: きごう
ops.fix: (null — whitespace token has no reading)

ops.fix: Question(s) (subject), there is one / one exists.
ops.issue: The subject is marked by が, not は, but the literal mirror renders it with the topic device 'As for...', conflating が with は — exactly the distinction the lit field exists to teach.

ops.current: Quanto a pergunta(s), uma (delas) existe / há.
ops.fix: Pergunta(s) (sujeito), uma (delas) existe / há.

ops.current: This table is very sturdy.

ops.current: As for the teacher, he said that he has already come back.

ops.current: small / short
ops.fix: small / quiet (of a voice)

ops.current: dia(dia de chuva: 雨の日)
ops.fix: dia (dia de chuva: 雨の日)

ops.current: このころすこしつかれている

ops.fix: this

ops.current: ころ
ops.fix: ごろ

ops.current: O foco de vocabulário (alvo 1285) é justamente この頃.
ops.fix: O foco de vocabulário é justamente この頃.

O verbo central é 疲れる (cansar-se) na forma 〜ている (疲れている), que aqui indica um estado resultante: não é a ação de cansar, mas a condição de estar cansado agora. O foco de vocabulário (alvo 1285) é justamente この頃.
ops.issue: Internal target ID '(alvo 1285)' leaked into learner-facing pt explanation; absent from expl_en. Should be removed.

ops.current: again
ops.fix: or (part of または)

ops.current: de novo
ops.fix: ou (parte de または)
ops.issue: また glossed 'de novo' (again), but in this sentence it is part of the conjunction または 'ou', the lesson target; the adverb gloss is wrong in context.

ops.current: My room faces south.

ops.current: Meu quarto fica para o lado sul.
ops.fix: Meu quarto fica do lado sul.
ops.issue: 'Fica para o lado sul' reads as orientation in BR Portuguese (the room faces south), but 南にあります states location; inconsistent with lit_pt 'ele existe ao sul' and the expl's location analysis.

ops.current: lugar (advérbio de lugar)
ops.fix: lugar (adjunto de lugar)

ops.current: The verb 始める here appears in dictionary form converted to the past by the auxiliary た.
ops.fix: The verb here is the plain past 始めた: the stem 始め of 始める + the past auxiliary た.
ops.full_before: The structure is simple: subject marked by が (男性が, 'the man'), object marked by を (話を, 'the conversation/the matter') and the main verb in the past, 始めた ('began'). The highlight is なにやら, an expression meaning 'something (one doesn't quite know what)', giving a vague tone to what the man went on to talk about. The verb 始める here appears in dictionary form converted to the past by the auxiliary た.
ops.issue: Self-contradictory conjugation claim: 始めた is not 'the dictionary form converted to the past by た'; it is the stem 始め + past auxiliary た (as the token note correctly says). As written it suggests attaching た to 始める.

ops.current: O verbo 始める aqui aparece na forma de dicionário convertida ao passado pelo auxiliar た.
ops.fix: O verbo aqui está no passado simples 始めた: raiz 始め de 始める + auxiliar de passado た.
ops.full_before: A estrutura é simples: sujeito marcado por が (男性が, 'o homem'), objeto marcado por を (話を, 'a conversa/o assunto') e o verbo principal no passado, 始めた ('começou'). O destaque é なにやら, uma expressão que significa 'algo (não se sabe bem o quê)', dando um tom vago ao que o homem foi falar. O verbo 始める aqui aparece na forma de dicionário convertida ao passado pelo auxiliar た.
ops.issue: Afirmação contraditória: 始めた não é 'a forma de dicionário convertida ao passado'; é a raiz 始め + auxiliar た (como a própria nota do token diz). Do jeito que está, sugere anexar た a 始める.

ops.current: Since there is no i-adjective/verb + だから here, and everything is well-formed, the sentence is natural.
ops.fix: The verb 進む is in the plain non-past (dictionary) form.
ops.full_before: The skeleton is simple: the subject 話 (conversation) marked by が and the verb 進む (to advance, to progress) at the end. The part なかなかいい感じで functions as an adverb: で here marks the manner/way (in what 'mood/feeling' the conversation happens), and なかなか intensifies いい感じ (a really good feeling). Since there is no i-adjective/verb + だから here, and everything is well-formed, the sentence is natural.
ops.issue: Final sentence is incoherent generation-time meta-commentary ('no i-adjective/verb + だから here... the sentence is natural') that has nothing to do with this sentence and will confuse learners. Replace with a useful closing fact.

ops.current: Como não há partícula い-adjetivo/verbo + だから aqui, e tudo está bem formado, a frase é natural.

A parte なかなかいい感じで funciona como um advérbio: で aqui marca o modo/maneira (em que 'clima/sensação' a conversa acontece), e なかなか intensifica いい感じ (uma sensação bem boa). Como não há partícula い-adjetivo/verbo + だから aqui, e tudo está bem formado, a frase é natural.

ops.current: The focus is the N4 narrative in the casual past.

ops.full_before: The structure is [subject + が] + [manner adjunct + で] + [object + を] + [verb]. 母親が is the subject (the mother), 一人で indicates the manner 'alone/on her own' (で of means/condition), and 四人の子供 ('four children') is the object, where 四人 (quantity) is linked to 子供 by の. The verb 育てた is the neutral past form of 育てる ('to raise, to bring up'). The focus is the N4 narrative in the casual past.
ops.issue: Internal level metadata leaked into learner-facing text: 'the N4 narrative' is meaningless to a learner (and the item is tagged n3). Should just describe the plain-past narration.

ops.current: O foco aqui é a narrativa N4 no passado casual.

ops.full_before: A estrutura é [sujeito + が] + [adjunto de modo + で] + [objeto + を] + [verbo]. 母親が é o sujeito (a mãe), 一人で indica o modo 'sozinha/por conta própria' (で de meio/condição), e 四人の子供 ('quatro filhos') é o objeto, onde 四人 (quantidade) se liga a 子供 por の. O verbo 育てた é a forma passada neutra de 育てる ('criar, educar'). O foco aqui é a narrativa N4 no passado casual.

ops.current: The target is coverage, practicing a color adjective + a verb in the continuous past aspect ています/ていた.
ops.fix: This sentence practices a color adjective + a verb in the past continuous aspect ていた.
ops.full_before: The sentence has topic + object + verb. 彼 ("he") is the topic, marked by は. The object is 赤いズボン ("red pants"), with the i-adjective 赤い qualifying ズボン, marked by を as the direct object. The verb はく ("to wear/put on", for clothing on the lower body) appears in the continuous past (はいて + いた): the て form + いる indicates a state/continuous action, and いた is in the past, giving "was wearing". The target is coverage, practicing a color adjective + a verb in the continuous past aspect ています/ていた.
ops.issue: Internal authoring jargon leaked into learner-facing text: 'The target is coverage' refers to the pipeline's grammar-target tag and is meaningless to a learner.

ops.current: O alvo é cobertura (coverage), praticando adjetivo de cor + verbo no aspecto contínuo ています/ていた no passado.
ops.fix: A frase pratica adjetivo de cor + verbo no aspecto contínuo ていた no passado.
ops.full_before: A frase tem tópico + objeto + verbo. 彼 ("ele") é o tópico, marcado por は. O objeto é 赤いズボン ("calça vermelha"), com o adjetivo-i 赤い qualificando ズボン, marcado por を como objeto direto. O verbo はく ("vestir/calçar", para roupas de baixo do corpo) aparece em ている (はいて + いた): a forma て + いる indica estado/ação contínua, e いた está no passado, dando "estava usando". O alvo é cobertura (coverage), praticando adjetivo de cor + verbo no aspecto contínuo ています/ていた no passado.
ops.issue: Same internal jargon leak as expl_en: 'O alvo é cobertura (coverage)' is pipeline metadata, not learner content.

ops.current: in the colloquial negative form 話しない (= relaxed 話さない)
ops.fix: Here it combines with 話 as a noun ('talk') plus する: 話(を)しない, colloquially reduced to 話しない (はなしない), i.e. the negative of する — 'we don't do that much talking'. This is casual speech, not a negative form of the godan verb 話す.
ops.full_before: The focus is そんなに, which means "that much / so" and modifies the verb, indicating degree. Here it combines with the verb 話す ("to talk") in the colloquial negative form 話しない (= relaxed 話さない) to say that one does NOT talk to that degree. The final particle よ adds a tone of assertion/information to the listener.
ops.issue: False conjugation claim: godan 話す has no colloquial negative 話しない, and it is not a 'relaxed' 話さない (relaxation gives 話さん etc.). The form is noun 話+(を)しない (negative of する), or at best a nonstandard analogical negation that must be flagged as nonstandard.

ops.current: na forma negativa coloquial 話しない (= 話さない relaxado)

ops.full_before: O foco é そんなに, que significa "tanto assim / tão" e modifica o verbo, indicando grau. Aqui ele combina com o verbo 話す ("conversar") na forma negativa coloquial 話しない (= 話さない relaxado) para dizer que NÃO se conversa nesse grau todo. A partícula final よ acrescenta um tom de afirmação/informação ao ouvinte.
ops.issue: Same false grammar claim as expl_en: 話しない is presented as negativa coloquial 'relaxada' de 話さない, which is not a real colloquial process for verbos godan; the correct analysis is substantivo 話 + (を)しない.

ops.current: Porém, por que mais, a um lugar deste tipo, (você) veio (é que é)?

ops.current: forma て 揺れて de 揉れる→揺れる, ligada a いる para o aspecto contínuo

ops.current: かれわわたしたちのしゃかいのあいだでわがくしゃでかよっている。

ops.current: vem ほやほや, um adjetivo expressivo (giongo) que reforça a ideia

Em seguida vem ほやほや, um adjetivo expressivo (giongo) que reforça a ideia de algo 'quentinho / fresquinho, acabado de fazer'. だ é a cópula casual e よ no final dá ênfase, como quem avisa algo ao interlocutor.

ops.current: O foco é coverage de 大勢 e do verbo 来る no passado educado.
ops.fix: O foco é a cobertura de 大勢 e do verbo 来る no passado educado.

O advérbio 大勢 (em grande número, falando de pessoas) modifica o verbo 来る (vir), que aparece no passado educado 来ました (来 + ました). A ordem é destino → sujeito → quantidade → verbo. O foco é coverage de 大勢 e do verbo 来る no passado educado.
ops.issue: English word "coverage" left untranslated in the pt-BR explanation.

ops.current: sujeito/complemento de なる
ops.fix: complemento de estado resultante (de なる)
ops.issue: 雨 is marked by に as the result complement of なる; it is not the subject (the implicit subject is the weather/sky). The 'sujeito/' alternative is wrong and should be dropped.

ops.current: てる (contração de ている); aqui 変わって + てた = 変わっていた ('tinha mudado / estava mudado')
ops.fix: てる = contração de ている; 変わっ+て+た forma 変わってた, contração de 変わっていた ('tinha mudado')
ops.issue: The note's equation is malformed: '変わって + てた = 変わっていた' would concatenate to 変わっててた. It should say 変わっ+て+た forms 変わってた, the contraction of 変わっていた. Same garbled equation in the en note.

ops.current: Don't be in such a hurry.
ops.fix: Don't rush me so much!
ops.issue: 急かす is transitive 'to rush/hurry someone along'; そんなに急かすなよ means 'don't rush ME so much'. 'Don't be in such a hurry' reverses the action (listener hurrying themselves = 急ぐ), contradicting pt 'Não me apressa tanto assim!' and the token gloss 'to rush (someone) along'.

ops.current: And he really is a teacher, isn't he?
ops.fix: And (you) are a teacher — that's the case, right?
ops.issue: Subject inconsistency within the record: en/pt render the subjectless JP as 'you're a teacher', but lit_en picks 'he', describing a different scenario. The literal gloss should keep the same implied referent as the natural translations.

ops.current: However much you do, there's more to see than the eye can take in.
ops.fix: No matter what one does, one's eyes end up going to the place one can see.
ops.issue: lit_en states a different proposition than the JP. 見えるところに目がいってしまう means 'the eyes end up going to the visible place', not 'there's more to see than the eye can take in' (abundance exceeding capacity). lit_pt mirrors the JP correctly; lit_en is a sense-changing mistranslation.

ops.current: あごに手をあて ('placing one's hand on one's chin', て-form of あてる)
ops.fix: あごに手をあて ('placing one's hand on one's chin', continuative 連用形 stem of あてる, used like あてて to chain clauses)
ops.full_before: The first part chains actions: あごに手をあて ('placing one's hand on one's chin', て-form of あてる) and 考えるふりをする ('to pretend to think'), with the pattern ～ふりをする. The conjunction が ('but') links to the second clause 何も浮かばない ('nothing comes to mind'), where 何も + a negative verb gives the sense of 'nothing'.
ops.issue: Wrong conjugation fact: あて is the continuative stem (連用形, 中止法) of あてる used to chain clauses; the て-form is あてて. Calling あて the 'て-form of あてる' teaches a false form.

ops.current: あごに手をあて ('encostando a mão no queixo', forma て de あてる)
ops.fix: あごに手をあて ('encostando a mão no queixo', forma conectiva 連用形 de あてる, equivalente a あてて)
ops.full_before: A primeira parte encadeia ações: あごに手をあて ('encostando a mão no queixo', forma て de あてる) e 考えるふりをする ('fingir que pensa'), com o padrão ～ふりをする. A conjunção が ('mas') liga à segunda oração 何も浮かばない ('nada vem à mente'), onde 何も + verbo negativo dá o sentido de 'nada'.
ops.issue: Same wrong conjugation fact as expl_en: あて é a forma 連用形 (conectiva/中止法) de あてる, não a forma て (que seria あてて).

ops.current: あごにてをあてかんがえるふりをするがなんもうかばない。
ops.fix: あごにてをあてかんがえるふりをするがなにもうかばない。
ops.issue: 何も is read なにも in this neutral/semi-literary sentence (note the literary 連用中止 あて); なんも is a very casual/dialectal variant that does not match the register. Romaji 'nanmo' inherits the same error.

ops.current: なん
ops.fix: なに
ops.issue: Reading of 何 in 何も should be なに (standard なにも); なん is the casual/dialectal contraction and clashes with the sentence's written register.

ops.current: あまりにあいてるとぎゃくにはいりづらい。
ops.fix: あまりにすいてるとぎゃくにはいりづらい。
ops.issue: 空いてる meaning 'empty/uncrowded (few people)' — the sense required by 'too empty → awkward to walk in' and by the translations 'too empty/vazio demais' — is read すいてる (空く=すく). あいてる (空く=あく) means 'vacant/available' and is the wrong reading here. Romaji 'aiteru' inherits it.

ops.current: あい
ops.fix: すい
ops.issue: In-context reading of 空い is すい (from 空く すく 'to be uncrowded/empty of people'), matching the gloss 'to be empty'; あい corresponds to the 'become vacant/available' sense, which does not fit this sentence.

ops.current: As for him, he rarely fails to work.
ops.fix: As for him, he rarely works (lit.: rarely + works-not).
ops.issue: 'He rarely fails to work' composes in English to 'he almost always works' — the opposite of めったに働かない. 'fails to' is not a mirror of ない; it inverts the sense.

ops.current: He [topic] cleverly fell into / got caught in the trap.
ops.fix: He [topic] fell right into / got neatly caught in the trap.
ops.issue: 'cleverly' misattributes skill to the victim; まんまと modifying the victim's verb かかった means 'completely / right into (the trap)', exactly as the token gloss says.

ops.current: Ele [tópico] habilmente armadilha em caiu/foi-pego.
ops.fix: Ele [tópico] direitinho armadilha em caiu/foi-pego.
ops.issue: 'habilmente' (skillfully) misattributes skill to the victim; まんまと here is 'direitinho/completamente', matching the token gloss and the pt translation.

ops.current: Ele é jovem de espírito.
ops.fix: Ele é realmente jovem de espírito.
ops.issue: The intensifier まったく (the very point highlighted in the explanation) is dropped in pt; en keeps it as 'quite'.

ops.current: ainda, todavia
ops.fix: ainda
ops.issue: 'todavia' in modern pt-BR is only adversative ('however/no entanto') — a false friend of English temporal 'yet'. It never glosses temporal まだ ('still').

ops.current: Ele-TÓPICO primeiro raramente barbeiro a vai-não.
ops.fix: Ele-TÓPICO praticamente raramente barbeiro a vai-não.
ops.issue: 'primeiro' renders the wrong sense of まず: combined with a negative (まず〜ない) it means 'practically/certainly (not)', not 'first'.

ops.current: (the target くなかった. At the end, the final particle の gives an explanatory/soft tone, like someone justifying or telling something.)
ops.fix: (the target くなかった). At the end, the final particle の gives an explanatory/soft tone, like someone justifying or telling something.
ops.full_before: The base is 行く (to go). From the stem 行き we form 行きたい (to want to go), and since 〜たい behaves like an i-adjective, the negative-past becomes 行きたくなかった (did not want to go) (the target くなかった. At the end, the final particle の gives an explanatory/soft tone, like someone justifying or telling something.)
ops.issue: Misplaced parenthesis: it opens before 'the target くなかった' and swallows the final two sentences about the particle の; it should close right after くなかった.

ops.current: (o foco-alvo くなかった. No fim, a partícula final の dá um tom explicativo/suave, como quem está justificando ou contando algo.)
ops.fix: (o foco-alvo くなかった). No fim, a partícula final の dá um tom explicativo/suave, como quem está justificando ou contando algo.
ops.full_before: A base é 行く (ir). Do radical 行き formamos 行きたい (querer ir), e como 〜たい se comporta como い-adjetivo, o negativo-passado vira 行きたくなかった (não queria ir) (o foco-alvo くなかった. No fim, a partícula final の dá um tom explicativo/suave, como quem está justificando ou contando algo.)
ops.issue: Same misplaced parenthesis as expl_en: it should close after くなかった instead of wrapping the last two sentences.

ops.current: なつやすみまで、あといちしゅうかんです。
ops.fix: なつやすみまで、あといっしゅうかんです。
ops.issue: Wrong reading of 一週間: it is read いっしゅうかん (with geminate っ), never いちしゅうかん.

ops.current: いち
ops.fix: いっ
ops.issue: In the compound 一週間 the numeral 一 is read いっ (isshuukan), not いち.

ops.current: natsuyasumimade,atoichishuukandesu.
ops.fix: natsuyasumimade,atoisshuukandesu.
ops.issue: Carries the same reading error as kana: 'ichishuukan' should be 'isshuukan' (this is a wrong syllable, separate from the known punctuation issue).

ops.current: As for him, what a detestable face (he has)!
ops.fix: As for him, what a detestable guy (he is)!
ops.issue: やつ means 'guy/fellow', not 'face' — looks like a back-translation of pt 'cara' via its wrong sense ('face'); '(he has)' compounds the error (JP has copula だ = 'he is').

ops.current: あのれすとらんわいつにしまるの?
ops.fix: あのれすとらんわなんじにしまるの?
ops.issue: 何時 is misread. With に and the meaning 'what time does it close', 何時 must be なんじ (nanji); いつに is not how this question is phrased. en/pt ('what time' / 'a que horas') confirm なんじ.

ops.current: anoresutoranwaitsunishimaruno?
ops.fix: anoresutoranwananjinishimaruno?
ops.issue: Follows the wrong kana reading: 'itsuni' should be 'nanjini' (何時に = nanji ni, 'at what time').

ops.current: いつ
ops.fix: なんじ
ops.issue: Token 何時 has reading いつ, but in 何時に閉まるの ('what time does it close') the reading is なんじ. いつ never takes に in this use.

ops.current: みょうごにちわかようびです。
ops.fix: あさってわかようびです。
ops.issue: kana transcribes 明後日 as みょうごにち while expl_en/expl_pt state it is 'read naturally as あさって'. For this everyday sentence あさって is the natural reading; transcription contradicts the explanation. Romaji would become asattewakayoubidesu.

ops.current: みょうごにち
ops.fix: あさって
ops.issue: Token reading みょうごにち contradicts the expl fields, which say 明後日 is naturally read あさって here; align token with the natural reading.

ops.current: that / that one (far from both)
ops.fix: that / that one (near the listener / just mentioned)
ops.issue: その is glossed with the あの description. その points to something near the listener or already mentioned; 'far from both speakers' is あの. Teaches the ko-so-a-do system wrongly.

ops.current: aquela / aquele (longe dos dois)
ops.fix: essa / esse (perto do ouvinte / já mencionado)
ops.issue: Same defect in pt: 'longe dos dois' describes あの, not その. In pt-BR その corresponds to 'esse/essa' (perto do ouvinte ou já mencionado).

ops.current: いる (radical い-) na construção ている; aqui em ましょう→ました indica estado contínuo no passado
ops.fix: いる (radical い-) na construção ている; aqui em ます→ました indica estado contínuo no passado (fix en note likewise)
ops.issue: Conjugation note (both pt-BR and en) says 'aqui em ましょう→ました' — ましょう is the volitional ('let's') and is unrelated; the polite past is ます→ました. As written it implies a false conjugation path.

ops.current: かれわそのはつめいものとされている。
ops.fix: かれわそのはつめいしゃとされている。
ops.issue: 発明者 is read はつめいしゃ (Sino-Japanese suffix 者 = しゃ), not はつめいもの. The kana teaches a wrong reading of the whole sentence.

ops.current: karewasonohatsumeimonotosareteiru.
ops.fix: karewasonohatsumeishatosareteiru.
ops.issue: Romaji propagates the wrong reading of 発明者 (hatsumeimono instead of hatsumeisha). Not the known punctuation/katakana issue — an actual wrong reading.

ops.current: もの
ops.fix: しゃ
ops.issue: Token 者 in the compound 発明者 must read しゃ; もの is the native-word reading (若者, 悪者) and never applies to 発明者.

ops.current: あんぜんようぱーてーしょんにからだ・て・ゆびがいれるか?
ops.fix: あんぜんようぱーてーしょんにからだ・て・ゆびがはいれるか?
ops.issue: 入れる here is the potential of 入る (can enter), read はいれる — the record's own expl says it is potential 'can enter', and が-subject confirms it. いれる would be transitive 'put in' and needs を.

ops.current: anzenyoupa-te-shonnikarada te yubigaireruka?
ops.fix: anzenyoupa-te-shonnikarada te yubigahaireruka?
ops.issue: Romaji propagates the wrong reading ireru for potential 入れる (haireru).

ops.current: いれる
ops.fix: はいれる
ops.issue: Reading of 入れる in this potential context ('can enter/fit', with が) is はいれる (potential of 入る), not いれる (transitive 'to put in').

ops.current: que transforma a semelhanca em advérbio de modo
ops.fix: que transforma a semelhança em advérbio de modo
ops.full_before: Aqui aparece de verdade o alvo みたいに: お父さんみたい ('parecido com o papai / igual ao papai') + に, que transforma a semelhanca em advérbio de modo ('do jeito do papai'). Depois vem パイロットになる ('virar piloto'), com a partícula に marcando o resultado, e たい indicando o desejo. Estrutura: [substantivo + みたいに] indica 'do mesmo modo que / como' o substantivo.
ops.issue: Typo: 'semelhanca' missing cedilla; should be 'semelhança'.

ops.current: しつもんせめにしてすみませんでした。
ops.fix: しつもんぜめにしてすみませんでした。
ops.issue: 質問攻め undergoes rendaku: しつもんぜめ, not しつもんせめ (as in 〜攻め compounds generally: 質問攻め・矢継ぎ早攻め).

ops.current: shitsumonsemenishitesumimasendeshita.
ops.fix: shitsumonzemenishitesumimasendeshita.
ops.issue: Romaji propagates the missing rendaku in 質問攻め (shitsumonseme instead of shitsumonzeme).

ops.current: せめ
ops.fix: ぜめ
ops.issue: As the second element of the compound 質問攻め, 攻め is voiced by rendaku: ぜめ.

ops.current: He's like a child, huh.
ops.fix: You're like a child, huh.
ops.issue: Person mismatch within the record: en and pt render the subjectless JP as 2nd person ('You're', 'Você'), but lit_en switches to 'He's', which could mislead a learner into thinking the JP marks 3rd person.

ops.current: Quanto a (nesta) fábrica, brinquedos está-se a fabricar.
ops.fix: Quanto a (nesta) fábrica, brinquedos estão sendo fabricados.
ops.issue: "está-se a fabricar" is European Portuguese (estar a + infinitive). Project hard rule is pt-BR only; BR uses the gerund.

ops.current: Since the target is coverage, observe the combination では (place + topic) and the continuous aspect ています.
ops.fix: Observe the combination では (place + topic) and the continuous aspect ています.
ops.full_before: Declarative sentence in the pattern 'in X, Y is done'. The place 工場 ('factory') is marked by で ('in/place of the action') and reinforced by は, which highlights it as the topic ('as for this factory…'). The object おもちゃ ('toys') takes を, and the predicate is 製造する ('to manufacture') in the 〜ている form (しています) indicating continuous/habitual activity, in the polite register with ます. Since the target is coverage, observe the combination では (place + topic) and the continuous aspect ています.
ops.issue: Internal authoring metadata leaked into learner-facing text: 'Since the target is coverage' references the corpus-internal target tag 'coverage' and is meaningless to a learner.

ops.current: Como o alvo é 'cobertura', observe a combinação では (local + tópico) e o aspecto contínuo ています.
ops.fix: Observe a combinação では (local + tópico) e o aspecto contínuo ています.
ops.full_before: Frase declarativa simples no padrão 'em X faz-se Y'. O lugar 工場 ('fábrica') é marcado por で ('em/local da ação') e reforçado por は, que o destaca como tópico ('quanto a esta fábrica…'). O objeto おもちゃ ('brinquedos') leva を, e o predicado é 製造する ('fabricar') na forma 〜ている (しています) indicando atividade contínua/habitual, em registro educado com ます. Como o alvo é 'cobertura', observe a combinação では (local + tópico) e o aspecto contínuo ています.
ops.issue: Same internal-metadata leak as expl_en: "Como o alvo é 'cobertura'" is corpus jargon, confusing in a learner explanation.

ops.current: He attended that meeting as the chairman's substitute.
ops.fix: He attended that meeting as the president's substitute.
ops.issue: 社長 is 'company president' (会長 = chairman); 'chairman's substitute' is inconsistent with the token gloss and pt, which both say president.

ops.current: I'll leave the TV on, okay.
ops.fix: TV, I'll watch (get it done in advance), okay.
ops.issue: 見とく = 見て+おく ('watch it / get the watching done in advance'), not 'leave the TV on' (that would be つけておく). The literal gloss changes the verb's action from watching to leaving powered on, contradicting en/pt and the token glosses.

ops.current: March is over.
ops.fix: March is coming to an end.
ops.issue: 終わる is non-past ('is ending / will end'), but 'March is over.' asserts a completed state (三月が終わった). It also contradicts the record's own expl_en, which says 'the month of March is coming to an end'.

ops.current: It's here, of course.
ops.fix: (He) is here — that's to be expected.
ops.issue: Literal mirror misrenders はずだ as 'of course' (certainty/naturalness) instead of logical expectation, and uses inanimate 'It' although いる is animate and en/pt use 'he'. lit_pt ('é de se esperar') is correct; lit_en does not match.

ops.current: かれわよんれいさいくらいです。
ops.fix: かれわよんじゅっさいくらいです。
ops.issue: ４０歳 is read よんじゅっさい (or よんじっさい), but the kana transcribes ４０ digit-by-digit as よんれい ('four-zero'), which is not a possible reading of 40 years old.

ops.current: karewayonreisaikuraidesu.
ops.fix: karewayonjussaikuraidesu.
ops.issue: Romaji inherits the wrong reading of ４０歳: 'yonreisai' instead of 'yonjussai'.

ops.current: よんれい
ops.fix: よんじゅっ
ops.issue: Token ４０ has reading よんれい ('four-zero'). Before the counter 歳 it must be よんじゅっ (yonjuss- with gemination; standalone form よんじゅう).

ops.current: Esse é o uso tipico de くらい como 'aproximadamente' apos quantidades.
ops.fix: Esse é o uso típico de くらい como 'aproximadamente' após quantidades.
ops.full_before: 彼 ('ele') é o tópico marcado por は. ４０歳 é 'quarenta anos' (numeral 40 + contador 歳 para idade). くらい depois do número indica aproximação ('cerca de, uns'), e です fecha como afirmação educada. Esse é o uso tipico de くらい como 'aproximadamente' apos quantidades.
ops.issue: Missing accents in the final sentence: 'tipico' should be 'típico' and 'apos' should be 'após'.

ops.current: As for tomorrow, I should get up early as usual, right.
ops.fix: As for tomorrow, not getting up early like always is fine, you know.
ops.issue: The literal English drops the negation of 早起きしなくていい ('not getting up early is fine') and states the opposite meaning ('I should get up early'). lit_pt has it right; lit_en contradicts jp, en, pt and the explanation.

ops.current: かれわいちきゅうななれいねんろくがついつかのあさしちじにうまれた。
ops.fix: かれわせんきゅうひゃくななじゅうねんろくがついつかのあさしちじにうまれた。
ops.issue: Year １９７０年 is transcribed digit-by-digit (いちきゅうななれい); Japanese reads years as full numbers: せんきゅうひゃくななじゅうねん. This sentence explicitly targets date/number coverage, so the reading model it teaches is wrong.

ops.current: karewaichikyuunanareinenrokugatsuitsukanoasashichijiniumareta.
ops.fix: karewasenkyuuhyakunanajuunenrokugatsuitsukanoasashichijiniumareta.
ops.issue: Romaji mirrors the wrong digit-by-digit year reading; 1970年 = senkyuuhyakunanajuunen.

ops.current: いちきゅうななれい
ops.fix: せんきゅうひゃくななじゅう
ops.issue: Numeral １９７０ before 年 is read digit-by-digit; the year reading is せんきゅうひゃくななじゅう.

ops.current: かれわいちれいてんいじょうあげるだろう。
ops.fix: かれわじゅってんいじょうあげるだろう。
ops.issue: １０点 is transcribed いちれいてん (digit-by-digit with れい for 0); the correct reading is じゅってん (or じってん).

ops.current: karewaichireitenijouagerudarou.
ops.fix: karewajuttenijouagerudarou.
ops.issue: Romaji mirrors the wrong digit reading; 10点 = jutten.

ops.current: いちれい
ops.fix: じゅっ
ops.issue: １０ is read いちれい; before 点 it is じゅっ (10点 = じゅってん).

ops.current: Ele provavelmente vai marcar mais de dez pontos.
ops.fix: Ele provavelmente vai marcar dez pontos ou mais.
ops.issue: 以上 is inclusive: 10点以上 = 'dez pontos ou mais'. 'Mais de dez pontos' excludes exactly ten and contradicts this sentence's own expl, which teaches 以上 = 'ou mais / a partir desse valor'.

ops.current: かれわいちれいれいどるばかりかそれいじょうもっている。
ops.fix: かれわひゃくどるばかりかそれいじょうもっている。
ops.issue: １００ドル is transcribed いちれいれいどる (digit-by-digit); the correct reading is ひゃくどる.

ops.current: karewaichireireidorubakarikasoreijoumotteiru.
ops.fix: karewahyakudorubakarikasoreijoumotteiru.
ops.issue: Romaji mirrors the wrong digit reading; 100ドル = hyakudoru.

ops.current: いちれいれい
ops.fix: ひゃく
ops.issue: １００ is read いちれいれい; should be ひゃく.

ops.current: なかなかきょうみふかいことをおっしゃいますね?
ops.fix: なかなかきょうみぶかいことをおっしゃいますね?
ops.issue: 興味深い has rendaku: きょうみぶかい, not きょうみふかい. The sibling sentence in this batch (それは、なかなか興味深いな) correctly uses ぶかい; dictionaries list only きょうみぶかい.

ops.current: nakanakakyoumifukaikotooosshaimasune?
ops.fix: nakanakakyoumibukaikotooosshaimasune?
ops.issue: kyoumifukai should be kyoumibukai (rendaku in 興味深い).

ops.current: ふかい
ops.fix: ぶかい
ops.issue: 深い inside the compound 興味深い is read ぶかい (rendaku), not ふかい.

ops.current: This is quite interesting, isn't it.
ops.fix: That is quite interesting, isn't it.
ops.issue: それ = 'that'; lit_en opens with 'This', mismatching both the JP and the natural en ('That's quite interesting'). lit_pt correctly has 'Isso'.

ops.current: きっちんようひんわ、ちかいちかいでございます。
ops.fix: きっちんようひんわ、ちかいっかいでございます。
ops.issue: 地下一階 is read ちかいちかい; 一階 has gemination: いっかい, so the phrase is ちかいっかい.

ops.current: kicchinyouhinwa,chikaichikaidegozaimasu.
ops.fix: kicchinyouhinwa,chikaikkaidegozaimasu.
ops.issue: chikaichikai should be chikaikkai (地下一階 = chika ikkai).

ops.fix: いっ

ops.fix: On the porch, a skunk (subject) is there.

ops.current: かれわ、どちらかというと、ぶんべつのあるひとだ。
ops.fix: かれわ、どちらかというと、ふんべつのあるひとだ。

ops.current: karewa,dochirakatoiuto,bunbetsunoaruhitoda.
ops.fix: karewa,dochirakatoiuto,funbetsunoaruhitoda.

ops.fix: ふんべつ
ops.issue: 分別 meaning 'discernment, common sense' (as glossed) reads ふんべつ; ぶんべつ belongs to the 'sorting' sense.

ops.current: Ele, se for o caso, é um homem sensato.
ops.fix: Ele, se for para escolher um lado, é um homem sensato.
ops.issue: 'Se for o caso' means 'if need be / if applicable' in pt-BR, which is not どちらかというと ('if anything / if I had to lean one way'). It clashes with the expl's own gloss ('se for para inclinar para um lado').

ops.current: onде 〜のように significa 'como/igual a' (comparação)
ops.fix: onde 〜のように significa 'como/igual a' (comparação)
ops.full_before: O tópico é 本棚には (na estante), marcado por に (lugar) reforçado por は (tópico/contraste). A oração relativa まだ読んでいない (que ainda não li) modifica 本 (livros): 読んでいる é a forma 〜ている (estado contínuo/perfectivo) e ない é a negação. O sujeito 本が é descrito por 山のようにある, onде 〜のように significa 'como/igual a' (comparação) e ある é o verbo 'haver/existir' para coisas inanimadas. O alvo é cobertura de vocabulário/estrutura básica N5.

ops.current: A fala dele era a ponto de dar para dizer que foi ridícula.
ops.fix: A fala dele chegava ao ponto de dar para dizer que era ridícula.

ops.current: Our English teacher is both strict and kind.
ops.fix: Our teacher is strict but kind.
ops.issue: The en translation adds 'English' (and 'both...and'), but the JP says only 私たちの先生 'our teacher' with contrastive けど 'but'. pt correctly has 'Nosso professor'. The addition misidentifies the subject and is unfaithful to jp.

ops.current: Almost the same as the first sentence, but without final よ.

ops.issue: Dangling cross-reference: 'Almost the same as the first sentence' refers to another batch item the learner cannot see; it also ends with pipeline meta-commentary ('Being N4 coverage only, no specific grammar point to confirm'). Needs a standalone rewrite.

ops.current: Praticamente igual à primeira frase, mas sem a partícula final よ.

O verbo 寄ろう é a forma volitiva ('vamos ~') de 寄る ('dar uma parada', 'passar por'), expressando um convite. 次のガソリンスタンド ('o próximo posto de gasolina') é o destino, marcado por に. Por ser apenas cobertura de N4, não há ponto gramatical específico a confirmar.
ops.issue: Same dangling cross-reference as expl_en: 'Praticamente igual à primeira frase' points to an item the learner cannot see, plus meta-commentary ('Por ser apenas cobertura de N4...'). Needs a standalone rewrite.

ops.current: There's no way that's certain, you know.
ops.fix: There's no way it's correct, you know.
ops.issue: Literal field mistranslates 正しい as 'certain'; 正しい means 'correct/right' (lit_pt correctly uses 'Certo'). 'There's no way that's certain' teaches a wrong word mapping and shifts the sense.

ops.current: nine
ops.fix: here / this place
ops.issue: ここ in ここに来た is the place demonstrative 'here'; gloss 'nine' belongs to ここの(つ)/九 and is nonsensical in this sentence.

ops.current: nove
ops.fix: aqui / este lugar
ops.issue: Same defect in the pt gloss: ここ means 'aqui', not the numeral 'nove'.

ops.current: 「つらいものって、すき?」「だいすき」
ops.fix: 「からいものって、すき?」「だいすき」
ops.issue: Wrong reading of 辛い in context: talking about liking spicy food (辛いもの), the reading is からい ('spicy'). つらい means 'painful/hard' and cannot modify もの in this sense.

ops.current: "tsuraimonotte,suki?""daisuki"
ops.fix: "karaimonotte,suki?""daisuki"
ops.issue: Romaji carries the same wrong reading: tsurai instead of karai for 辛い ('spicy') in this food context.

ops.current: つらい
ops.fix: からい
ops.issue: Token 辛い glossed 'spicy (hot)/picante' but reading given as つらい ('painful'). In the 'spicy' sense it must be read からい, matching the gloss and the dialogue about food.

ops.current: If you could do that, would you?
ops.fix: If you could do it, what would you do?
ops.issue: どうする？ is an open question 'what would you do?'. The en turns it into a yes/no question ('would you?'), mismatching jp and contradicting the item's own pt ('o que faria?') and lit_en ('what would you do?').

ops.current: し é する; junto com たら forma としたら 'supondo que' (a glosa 'to print' está errada)
ops.fix: し é する; junto com たら forma としたら 'supondo que'
ops.issue: Learner-facing note contains a leftover QA meta-comment — "(a glosa 'to print' está errada)" / "(the gloss 'to print' is wrong)" — referring to a gloss that no longer exists (current gloss is 'to suppose'). Remove the parenthetical from both pt-BR and en note versions.

ops.current: a glosa 'motion' está errada; どう significa 'como'
ops.fix: Set note to null in both pt-BR and en (or replace with a substantive note, e.g. pt-BR: "どう ('como') combina com する formando a pergunta どうする？" / en: "どう ('how') combines with する to form the question どうする？").
ops.issue: The entire note on どう is a leftover QA meta-comment ("the gloss 'motion' is wrong") about a gloss that was already fixed (current gloss 'how / in what way' is correct). Remove or replace with a real note in both languages.

ops.current: 仕方 on a verb stem (here 運転) forms 'the way to do something'
ops.fix: 仕方 linked by の to a verbal noun (運転の仕方) forms 'the way to do something'
ops.full_before: Topic 運転の仕方 ('the way of driving'), by は: 仕方 on a verb stem (here 運転) forms 'the way to do something'. Main verb 教えてくれた: 〜てくれる indicates someone did something FOR the speaker's BENEFIT (the parents taught 'for me'). んだ (contraction of のだ) gives an explanatory tone, telling the reason.
ops.issue: Misstates the construction: 仕方 does not attach to a verb stem here; it is linked by の to the verbal noun 運転 (運転の仕方). 'Verb stem + 仕方' would license wrong forms like *読み仕方 (the productive stem pattern is V-stem + 方).

ops.current: 仕方 anexado à raiz de um verbo (aqui 運転 'dirigir') forma 'a maneira de fazer algo'
ops.fix: 仕方 ligado por の ao substantivo verbal (運転の仕方) forma 'a maneira de fazer algo'
ops.full_before: O tópico é 運転の仕方 ('o modo de dirigir'), marcado por は: 仕方 anexado à raiz de um verbo (aqui 運転 'dirigir') forma 'a maneira de fazer algo'. O verbo principal é 教えてくれた: a estrutura 〜てくれる indica que alguém fez algo EM BENEFÍCIO do falante (os pais ensinaram 'para mim'). No fim, んだ (contração de のだ) dá um tom explicativo/de quem está contando o porquê de algo.
ops.issue: Same wrong claim as expl_en: 仕方 is not attached to 'a raiz de um verbo' here; 運転 is a substantivo verbal ligado a 仕方 pela partícula の (運転の仕方).

ops.current: pega-se o verbo やる ('fazer/praticar') na forma で た→ raiz やっ, junta-se たり
ops.fix: pega-se o verbo やる ('fazer/praticar') na raiz やっ, junta-se たり
ops.full_before: Aqui aparece o alvo 〜たりする: pega-se o verbo やる ('fazer/praticar') na forma で た→ raiz やっ, junta-se たり e fecha-se com する, formando やったりする = 'fazer coisas como jogar / jogar e tal'. Esse padrão dá um tom de exemplo não exaustivo, suavizando a pergunta ('você costuma jogar futebol americano, entre outras coisas?'). って é um marcador de tópico coloquial (= は), e o ？ final indica pergunta informal.
ops.issue: Garbled fragment 'na forma で た→ raiz やっ' (stray Japanese で and arrow); the English version says simply 'in its stem やっ'.

ops.current: I'll keep thinking about it later.
ops.fix: Later, I'll think it over (and leave it settled).
ops.issue: Misleading mirror of 〜ておく: 'keep thinking' reads as continuative aspect, but 考えとく means 'think it over (and leave it settled) in advance'. lit_pt ('Depois deixo pensado') has it right; lit_en teaches the wrong aspect.

ops.current: かれのおかあさんわねんのわりにわわかくみえる。
ops.fix: かれのおかあさんわとしのわりにわわかくみえる。
ops.issue: 年 in the set phrase 年のわりに(は) ('for one's age') is read とし, not ねん; ねん is only for 'year' in counting/compound contexts. Error also propagates to romaji (nennowariniwa).

ops.current: ねん
ops.fix: とし
ops.issue: Token 年 glossed as 'age' (idade) in 年のわりには must be read とし in this context; ねん is the wrong reading for the 'age' sense.

ops.current: If you hear the answer, you'll probably be surprised.
ops.fix: If you hear the answer, you might be surprised.
ops.issue: Modality mismatch: かも = 'might/maybe' (possibility), not 'probably' (likelihood). expl and lit_pt ('talvez') say maybe; 'probably' misteaches かも in the structural gloss.

ops.current: He really gets across me.
ops.fix: He really irritates me.
ops.issue: 'Gets across me' is an obscure, dated British/Australian idiom (Tanaka-corpus artifact); most readers will find it odd or unparseable. Replace with standard English.

ops.current: As for him, he really makes me irritated.
ops.fix: As for him, (I) am really made to get irritated.
ops.issue: The literal gloss recasts the causative-passive させられる as active ('he makes me irritated'), erasing the target structure; lit_pt and the parallel item sent:tatoeba-119009 correctly mirror '(I) am made to...'.

ops.current: (suffix) study / -ology
ops.fix: study / learning (first part of 学部 'faculty/department')
ops.issue: Wrong-sense gloss: in 主力学部, 学 is not the '-ology' suffix (that is field+学, e.g. 生物学); here it is the first element of the single word 学部 'faculty' (which is even one token earlier in this same sentence). Role 'sufixo' repeats the misanalysis; ideally merge 学+部 into 学部.

ops.current: みょうごにちわ、もくようびよ。
ops.fix: あさってわ、もくようびよ。
ops.issue: Register-wrong reading in context: casual spoken sentence (bare noun + final よ) would be read あさって; みょうごにち is a stiff/formal reading (likely analyzer artifact) and clashes with the register. Align romaji (asattewa,mokuyoubiyo.) too.

ops.current: みょうごにち
ops.fix: あさって
ops.issue: Same reading issue as kana: 明後日 in this casual sentence should be read あさって, not the formal みょうごにち.

ops.current: I asked him to do it this way.
ops.fix: I asked him to do it that way.
ops.issue: そう is the anaphoric/distal demonstrative ('that way / so'), not 'this way' (こう); expl_en itself glosses it as 'do it that way'. Internal inconsistency plus wrong demonstrative.

ops.current: like this
ops.fix: like that / so
ops.issue: Gloss uses the wrong demonstrative: そう = 'like that / so'; 'like this' corresponds to こう. The sentence's own expl_en renders it 'that way'.

ops.current: There's a funny smell to it.
ops.fix: The tap water is strange. There's some good smell to it.
ops.full_before: The tap water is strange. There's a funny smell to it.
ops.issue: Sense-changing error in the literal gloss: 何かいい匂いがする = 'some GOOD smell'; 'funny smell' means an odd/suspicious smell — the opposite nuance, and contradicts en/pt/tokens (いい = good). lit_pt has it right ('um bom cheiro').

ops.current: Here いっぱい functions as a noun predicate with the sense of 'full/packed,' in the pattern 〜でいっぱい ('full of').
ops.fix: いっぱい here is a quantity predicate ('a lot'): 車が + いっぱい + でした (polite past copula); NOT the 〜でいっぱい pattern, which requires で (車でいっぱい).
ops.full_before: Here いっぱい functions as a noun predicate with the sense of 'full/packed,' in the pattern 〜でいっぱい ('full of'). The subject 車 ('cars') is marked by が, and でした is the polite past of です, giving 'was full (of cars).' It is the use of いっぱい as a state of being packed.
ops.issue: Wrong grammar claim: the sentence is 車が + いっぱい + でした (quantity predicate + polite past copula). It is NOT the 〜でいっぱい 'full of' pattern — that requires で before いっぱい (車でいっぱい). Learner may misparse でした's で as part of でいっぱい.

ops.current: Aqui いっぱい funciona como predicado nominal com o sentido de 'cheio/lotado', no padrão 〜でいっぱい ('cheio de').
ops.fix: いっぱい aqui é predicado de quantidade ('um monte'): 車が + いっぱい + でした (passado polido); NÃO é o padrão 〜でいっぱい, que exige で (車でいっぱい).
ops.full_before: Aqui いっぱい funciona como predicado nominal com o sentido de 'cheio/lotado', no padrão 〜でいっぱい ('cheio de'). O sujeito 車 ('carro') é marcado por が, e でした é o passado polido de です, dando 'estava cheio (de carros)'. É o uso de いっぱい como estado de lotação.
ops.issue: Same wrong grammar claim as expl_en: asserts the sentence instantiates o padrão 〜でいっぱい, but there is no で before いっぱい here; でした is the polite past copula. Teaches a false parse.

ops.current: There was no choice but to wait outside until he returned.
ops.fix: There was no way other than waiting until he came back.
ops.issue: 'to wait outside until he returned' reads as a spatial location that is not in the Japanese; 以外 here means 'other than (waiting)'. lit_pt handles it correctly ('fora-de (além de)'); lit_en as written adds false information.

ops.current: As for the bathroom, it's the stairs at the back.
ops.fix: As for the bathroom, it's the back of (behind) the stairs.
ops.issue: Head reversal: 階段の後ろ = 'the back of / behind the stairs'; 'the stairs at the back' would be 後ろの階段. Contradicts the (correct) expl_en and en.

ops.current: is, becomes
ops.fix: is / is located
ops.issue: です glossed as 'is, becomes': 'becomes' is not a sense of です (apparent back-translation of pt 'fica', which here is the locational 'is located', not 'becomes'). Teaches a false meaning of the copula.

ops.current: There are times when [I] do [it] (it's that).
ops.fix: Things to do exist (it's that).
ops.issue: lit_en renders the habitual sense of ~ことがある ('there are times when I do it'), but this sentence is the existence sense ('there are things to do'), exactly as expl_en/expl_pt and en/pt state. The literal contradicts the lesson and teaches the wrong parse.

ops.current: wish ('oh, if only I had...'. This combination 〜ばなあ is the typical way of expressing a longing in Japanese.)
ops.fix: wish ('oh, if only I had...'). This combination 〜ばなあ is the typical way of expressing a longing in Japanese.
ops.full_before: The sentence combines the conditional 〜ば with the emotional particle なあ, which is the target: 車があれば means 'if (I) had a car' (ある in the conditional form あれば), and なあ at the end turns the condition into an unrealized wish ('oh, if only I had...'. This combination 〜ばなあ is the typical way of expressing a longing in Japanese.)
ops.issue: Misplaced parenthesis: the paren opened before 'oh, if only I had...' is never closed after the quote; instead the closing paren wrongly wraps the entire following sentence.

ops.current: ('ah, se ao menos eu tivesse...'. Essa combinação 〜ばなあ é a forma típica de expressar um anseio em japonês.)
ops.fix: ('ah, se ao menos eu tivesse...'). Essa combinação 〜ばなあ é a forma típica de expressar um anseio em japonês.
ops.full_before: A frase combina a condicional 〜ば com a partícula emotiva なあ, que é o alvo: 車があれば significa 'se (eu) tivesse carro' (ある na forma condicional あれば), e なあ no fim transforma a condição em desejo não realizado ('ah, se ao menos eu tivesse...'. Essa combinação 〜ばなあ é a forma típica de expressar um anseio em japonês.)
ops.issue: Same misplaced parenthesis as expl_en: the closing paren wrongly wraps the whole following sentence instead of closing right after the quoted gloss.

ops.current: なんがおわるのか。
ops.fix: なにがおわるのか。
ops.issue: Wrong reading of 何 before が: it must be なに (なにが), not なん. なん is used only before だ/で/と/の and counters. The kana teaches an incorrect pronunciation of the whole sentence.

ops.current: なん
ops.fix: なに
ops.issue: Token 何 has reading なん, but before the particle が the correct reading is なに (なにが終わる).

ops.current: nangaowarunoka.
ops.fix: nanigaowarunoka.
ops.issue: Romaji inherits the wrong 何 reading (nanga instead of naniga); must be corrected together with the kana.

ops.current: You can't help but take off your socks (must take them off).
ops.fix: Socks — if (I) don't take (them) off (it won't do).
ops.issue: Literal mirror misrepresents 脱がなきゃ: 'can't help but take off' reads as inevitability (〜ざるを得ない), not the negative conditional with implied ならない; it also switches the subject to 'you' while en/pt use 'I'.

ops.current: As for having stopped, I haven't.
ops.fix: As for the act of stopping, there is none (it never stops).
ops.issue: Literal mirror renders the wrong construction: 'As for having stopped, I haven't' mirrors past-experience 止まったことはない (1st person), but the sentence is non-past 止まることはない ('the act of stopping does not exist'). Contradicts en ('It never stops') and the correct lit_pt.

ops.current: Ele hospedar-se num hotel barato daquele tipo (uma coisa dessas é estranho.)
ops.fix: Ele hospedar-se num hotel barato daquele tipo (uma coisa dessas) é estranho.
ops.issue: Misplaced parenthesis garbles the mirror: the main predicate 'é estranho' is trapped inside the parenthetical, and the final period sits inside the parens.

ops.current: It's not unreasonable for him to get angry over what you did, is it.

ops.current: いちさんにしてわすごくせがたかかった。
ops.fix: じゅうさんにしてわすごくせがたかかった。

ops.current: いちさん
ops.fix: じゅうさん
ops.issue: Token reading for surface 13 is いちさん (digit-by-digit); the correct reading for thirteen (years old) is じゅうさん.

ops.current: ichisannishitewasugokusegatakakatta.

ops.fix: Even though you saw it (and still pretend not to)...
ops.issue: Subject inconsistency: lit_en uses 'he... pretends', but en/pt/expl all frame the sentence as accusing the listener ('you'). Should match the second-person reading.

ops.current: Passa aqui qualquer dia, aproveitando quando for fazer compras.
ops.fix: Dê uma passada aqui qualquer dia, aproveitando quando for fazer compras.

ops.current: minna,chiekkugakibishiina.
ops.fix: minna,chekkugakibishiina.
ops.issue: ちぇ mis-romanized as 'chie' (ちえ): チェック = chekku, not chiekku. This is a wrong syllable, not the known unromanized-katakana issue.

ops.current: nominalizado por というこ と, e termina em はない
ops.fix: nominalizado por ということ, e termina em はない
ops.full_before: A frase encadeia 学べない ('não conseguir aprender'), nominalizado por というこ と, e termina em はない ('não existe / não é o caso'), formando 〜ということはない ('não há isso de...'). 年を取り過ぎて ('por ter envelhecido demais') é a causa. O と aqui faz parte de という (citação/nominalização), não do condicional.
ops.issue: Stray space inside ということ: text reads 'というこ と', splitting the nominalizer.

ops.current: They say it makes no difference whether (one is) rich!
ops.fix: Whether (one is) rich or not, it makes no difference — I'm telling you!
ops.issue: Sentence-final って is the emphatic assertive quotative ('I'm telling you'), as expl_en/expl_pt state and as en ('I don't care...') implies; lit_en misreads it as hearsay 'They say'.

ops.current: Rico se-ou-não, qualquer-que-seja tanto-faz dizem/que!
ops.fix: Rico se-ou-não, qualquer-que-seja tanto-faz, tô dizendo!

ops.current: Both cat and shell (= anyone at all) show a desire to go abroad.
ops.fix: Both cat and rice scoop (= anyone at all) show a desire to go abroad.
ops.issue: 杓子 rendered as 'shell'; it is a ladle/rice scoop (expl_en itself says 'rice scoop'). 'Shell' teaches a wrong word image; pt 'concha' is correct only in its ladle sense.

ops.current: それを仕上げる (to complete it) is the nominalized clause serving as the theme
ops.fix: それを仕上げる (to finish it) is a plain-form clause modifying 必要 ('the need to finish it')
ops.full_before: 日曜日まで (by Sunday) marks the deadline. それを仕上げる (to complete it) is the nominalized clause serving as the theme; 仕上げる carries the sense of 〜上げる, to finish entirely. 必要がある (there is a need) affirms the obligation: 必要 (need) + が + ある (to exist).
ops.issue: Misparses the syntax: それを仕上げる is not a 'nominalized clause serving as the theme' (no nominalizer, no topic marking); it is a plain-form attributive clause modifying 必要.

ops.current: それを仕上げる (concluir isso) é a oração nominalizada que serve de tema
ops.fix: それを仕上げる (concluir isso) é uma oração que modifica 必要 ('a necessidade de concluir isso')
ops.full_before: 日曜日まで (até domingo) marca o prazo. それを仕上げる (concluir isso) é a oração nominalizada que serve de tema; 仕上げる carrega o sentido de 〜上げる, terminar por completo. 必要がある (há necessidade) afirma a obrigação: 必要 (necessidade) + が + ある (existir).
ops.issue: Same misparse as expl_en: それを仕上げる is not 'oração nominalizada que serve de tema'; it is an attributive plain-form clause modifying 必要.

ops.current: As for him, it's as if he were her younger brother.
ops.fix: As for him, it's as if he were your younger brother.
ops.issue: 君の means 'your' (addressee's), but lit_en renders it as 'her', changing the referent. lit_pt correctly has 'seu' (your).

ops.current: bem (forma de いい/よい em よくない = não é bom)
ops.fix: bom
ops.issue: pt gloss for よい is a misplaced gloss from another sentence: it explains よく inside よくない ('não é bom'), which does not occur here. In context よい is simply the attributive adjective 'good' modifying 習慣 (en gloss correctly says 'good').

ops.current: Note the target here is only N4 vocabulary and structure coverage.

A is 日がたつ ('the days pass') and B is はずみがついた ('the momentum took hold'). はずみがつく is idiomatic: lit. 'the impulse catches on', i.e. something 'gains momentum'. つく appears as ついた (past). Note the target here is only N4 vocabulary and structure coverage.
ops.issue: Stray editorial meta-note contradicts the record: sentence is tagged n1 and につれて is well above N4; the sentence claiming 'the target here is only N4 vocabulary and structure coverage' is false and should be removed from the learner-facing explanation.

ops.current: nine

ops.fix: Me mudei para um apartamento novo.

ops.current: ふたりわなんをしているところですか。
ops.fix: ふたりわなにをしているところですか。
ops.issue: 何 before を must be read なに, not なん (なん only before だ/です/の/counters). Kana has なんを for 何をしている.

ops.current: futariwananoshiteirutokorodesuka.
ops.fix: futariwananioshiteirutokorodesuka.

ops.current: なん
ops.fix: なに

ops.current: O foco é coverage de には e do adjetivo 多い.
ops.fix: O foco é a cobertura de には e do adjetivo 多い.
ops.full_before: A expressão de tempo 二月 (fevereiro) é marcada por に (em/ponto no tempo) e reforçada por は, formando には, que destaca 'quanto a fevereiro'. O sujeito 雪 (neve) é marcado por が, e o predicado é o adjetivo-i 多い (ser muito/abundante), que encerra a frase no estilo informal. Literalmente 'quanto a fevereiro, a neve é muita' = 'em fevereiro neva muito'. O foco é coverage de には e do adjetivo 多い.
ops.issue: English word 'coverage' left untranslated in the pt-BR explanation; other items in the corpus use 'cobertura'.

ops.current: Dois, três desvantagens existem, né.
ops.fix: Duas, três desvantagens existem, né.
ops.issue: Gender agreement error in Portuguese: 'desvantagens' is feminine, so the numeral must be 'Duas', not 'Dois' (the natural pt correctly uses 'duas ou três').

ops.current: is/becomes
ops.fix: is (here locative: is located)
ops.issue: です glossed as 'is/becomes' — です never means 'becomes' (that is なる). The gloss mirrors pt 'fica', which here is locative ('is located'), not 'become'. Teaches a false meaning of the copula.

ops.current: Here the pattern 〜ようにしましょう appears in a question with the interrogative どの ('which')
ops.fix: どのように is the interrogative 'in what way / how' (どの + よう + に), and しましょう is the polite volitional of the main verb する — this is NOT the 〜ようにする ('make sure to') pattern, only a coincidental string overlap: どのようにしましょう = 'how shall we do it?'
ops.full_before: Here the pattern 〜ようにしましょう appears in a question with the interrogative どの ('which'): どのようにしましょう = 'in what way / how shall we do it?' 内訳は is the topic ('as for the breakdown/itemization'). It is a polite way of asking how the listener wants something to be done or divided.
ops.issue: Wrong grammar identification: どのようにしましょう is NOT the 〜ようにしましょう ('make sure to') pattern; it is the interrogative adverb どのように (どの+よう+に, 'in what way') + volitional しましょう of main-verb する. Only a coincidental string overlap; the token notes analyze it correctly.

ops.current: Aqui o padrão 〜ようにしましょう aparece em pergunta com a interrogativa どの ('qual')
ops.fix: どのように é o interrogativo 'de que modo / como' (どの + よう + に), e しましょう é o volitivo polido do verbo principal する — NÃO é o padrão 〜ようにする ('procurar fazer'), apenas coincidência de sequência: どのようにしましょう = 'como faremos?'
ops.full_before: Aqui o padrão 〜ようにしましょう aparece em pergunta com a interrogativa どの ('qual'): どのようにしましょう = 'de que modo / como faremos?'. 内訳は é o tópico ('quanto ao detalhamento/discriminação'). É uma forma educada de perguntar como o interlocutor quer que algo seja feito ou dividido.
ops.issue: Same wrong grammar claim as expl_en: identifies どのようにしましょう as the pattern 〜ようにしましょう, but it is the interrogative どのように + volitivo しましょう of する, not the 〜ようにする construction.

ops.current: the sequence 'はず' only shows up as a piece of the words はずっと/のぼり
ops.fix: the sequence 'はず' only shows up across は + ずっと (particle + adverb)
ops.full_before: Simple sentence of the type 'A は B だ' (topic + nominal predicate): 道 is the topic and のぼり ('uphill, climb') is the predicate, linked by the copula だ. The adverb ずっと reinforces that this applies 'the whole way, without stopping.' Note: although the target is はず, it does NOT appear here (the sequence 'はず' only shows up as a piece of the words はずっと/のぼり, so no grammatical pattern of supposition applies).
ops.issue: Garbled disclaimer: the string はず arises only from は + ずっと; のぼり contains no はず, so 'a piece of the words はずっと/のぼり' is confusing/incorrect. Same slip in expl_pt ('pedaço das palavras はずっと/のぼり').

ops.current: a sequência 'はず' só surge como pedaço das palavras はずっと/のぼり
ops.fix: a sequência 'はず' só surge atravessando は + ずっと (partícula + advérbio)
ops.full_before: Frase simples do tipo 'A は B だ' (tópico + predicado nominal): 道 é o tópico e のぼり ('subida, aclive') é o predicado, ligado pela cópula だ. O advérbio ずっと reforça que isso vale 'o tempo/caminho todo, sem parar'. Atenção: embora o alvo seja はず, ele NÃO aparece aqui (a sequência 'はず' só surge como pedaço das palavras はずっと/のぼり, então nenhum padrão gramatical de suposição se aplica.)
ops.issue: Same slip as expl_en: のぼり does not contain the string はず; it only spans は + ずっと.

ops.current: Como a estrada esta ruim, não da para acelerar.
ops.fix: Como a estrada está ruim, não dá para acelerar.
ops.issue: Missing accents on two verbs: 'esta' should be 'está' and 'da' should be 'dá'; as written they spell different words (demonstrative 'esta', preposition 'da').

ops.current: みちがふつつのこみちにわかれるところえきた。
ops.fix: みちがふたつのこみちにわかれるところえきた。

ops.current: o que aparece é 何度+も (もする = 'fazer')

O advérbio de frequência é 何度 ('quantas vezes') + も, que junto significa 'muitas/várias vezes'. Atenção ao alvo proposto もし ('se', condicional): ele NÃO ocorre aqui, o que aparece é 何度+も (もする = 'fazer'), nada a ver com a conjunção condicional もし.
ops.issue: Garbled parenthetical: '(もする = 'fazer')' presents もする as one unit meaning 'fazer'; the English version has '(with する = 'to do')', so the pt should read '(com する = 'fazer')'.

ops.current: esse, esse(a) (próximo do ouvinte)

ops.current: to be / the one(s) that
ops.fix: being / the one(s) that
ops.issue: もの here is the nominalizer noun ('the ones that are carnivorous'); the gloss 'to be' is a verb and fits no sense of もの — it is a calque of the pt noun 'ser' (a being).

ops.current: Por-algum-tempo o intervalo, da minha irmã-mais-velha, no supermercado, atendente está-fazendo.

ops.full_before: A frase usa a construção de foco 「〜のは〜だ」: 「電話を発明した」 (inventou o telefone) é nominalizado por 「の」 e marcado por 「は」 como o tema já conhecido, e a parte nova/focalizada é 「だれ」 (quem), fechada por 「ですか」. Essa estrutura serve para destacar a informação buscada: 'aquele que inventou o telefone (quem é?'.)
ops.issue: Mangled punctuation at the end: closing quote and period are inside the parenthesis — "(quem é?'.)" — leaving the quote opened before 'aquele' unclosed properly.

ops.current: raiz conectiva sonorizada (音便) de 入る ligada a た: 入った ('entrou')

ops.current: raiz conectiva sonorizada (音便) de 入る ligada a た: 入った ('entrou')
ops.fix: raiz conectiva geminada (促音便) de 入る ligada a た: 入った ('entrou')

ops.current: In the garden, the roses are blooming.
ops.fix: The garden's roses are blooming.
ops.issue: Mirror misparses genitive 庭の ('the garden's', noun-linking の) as a locative adjunct 'In the garden,', contradicting the expl, which correctly teaches の as possession; lit_pt keeps the genitive.

ops.current: Well now, that was it, you see.
ops.fix: Just now — (he) is right at the point of having gone, you know.
ops.issue: Literal mirror conveys a wrong meaning: たった今、行ったところよ = '(he) has just gone this very moment'. 'Well now, that was it, you see' misreads both たった今 and 〜たところ and teaches a false structure.

ops.current: Bem-agora, foi-ponto, viu.
ops.fix: Agora mesmo, (é) o momento de ter ido (acabou de ir), viu.
ops.issue: 'Bem-agora, foi-ponto, viu.' is unintelligible in Portuguese and drops the 〜たところ 'acabou de' (just-completed) meaning the field should mirror.

ops.current: forma 音便 (い-onbin) de 行く, base para o passado た → 行った
ops.fix: pt-BR: "forma 音便 (促音便, com っ — 行く é exceção, não usa い-onbin), base para o passado た → 行った"; en: "音便 form (促音便 with っ — 行く is the exception, not い-onbin), base for the past た → 行った" (also fixes the stray space before the comma in the proposed text).
ops.issue: Note claims 行っ is い-onbin of 行く. False: 行く is the classic exception that takes 促音便 (行って/行った), not い音便 (*行いた). Teaches a wrong conjugation rule; the en note repeats the error.

ops.current: predicado nominal (sujeito da hipótese)
ops.fix: predicado nominal (da hipótese 'se eu fosse')
ops.issue: Parenthetical '(sujeito da hipótese)' contradicts the correct main label: in 鳥だったら, 鳥 is the nominal predicate of the copula; the implied subject is 'eu'.

ops.current: Longamente durou partida que finalmente terminou.
ops.fix: A partida que longamente durou finalmente terminou.
ops.issue: Relative/main clause inverted: the PT parses as 'the match that finally ended lasted long', but the JP asserts that the match (which had lasted long) finally ended — as lit_en correctly renders. The mirror attaches 'que' to the wrong clause.

ops.current: to become, to be (animate being)
ops.fix: to stay, to be (animate being)
ops.issue: いる means 'to stay / to be', never 'to become'; 'to become' is the meaning of なる, which appears two tokens later in the same ことになる pattern, so this gloss actively confuses the two verbs. The pt gloss ('ficar, estar') is correct.

ops.current: fazer (aqui: 'estar em', formando 流行する)
ops.fix: fazer (aqui: 'estar em voga', formando 流行する)
ops.issue: Truncated gloss: "aqui: 'estar em'" is cut off (dangling preposition); the EN counterpart reads 'to be in vogue'. Should be 'estar em voga' or 'estar na moda'.

ops.current: ちょうしょくわいつにいたしますか。
ops.fix: ちょうしょくわなんじにいたしますか。
ops.issue: 何時 must be read なんじ here: the sentence asks a clock time with に (en: 'What time...?', pt: 'A que horas...?'). いつ ('when') does not take に in this scheduling sense; なんじに is the standard reading.

ops.current: いつ
ops.fix: なんじ
ops.issue: Reading of token 何時 given as いつ; in this context (specific hour, followed by に, glossed 'what time / a que horas') the correct reading is なんじ.

ops.current: choushokuwaitsuniitashimasuka.
ops.fix: choushokuwananjiniitashimasuka.
ops.issue: Romaji encodes the same wrong reading いつ for 何時; should follow the correct reading なんじ (nanji).

ops.current: Go and try (it).
ops.fix: Trying, (I) go on (from here).
ops.issue: Literal inverts the 〜ていく structure: 試していく is try(-te) + いく (continuation onward), but 'Go and try (it)' reads as motion-then-action (= 行って試す) and as an imperative, not a first-person statement.

ops.current: You won't take a break in the middle, right?
ops.fix: Let's take a break in the middle — isn't it (a good idea)?
ops.issue: Literal misparses the structure: しよう is volitional ('let's do'), and じゃないか is an invitation tag. 'You won't take a break…, right?' turns it into a negated second-person question — the opposite speech act, contradicting expl_en/expl_pt.

ops.current: It seems there are no instructions, huh.
ops.fix: It looks as if (he) has no learning (education), huh.
ops.issue: 学 means learning/education (pt 'instrução' is right), but English 'instructions' means directions/orders — a different sense. 'There are no instructions' misrepresents the sentence.

ops.current: きのみぎのままでかじからにげた。
ops.fix: きのみきのままでかじからにげた。
ops.issue: Wrong reading of the idiom 着の身着のまま: it is きのみきのまま (both 着 read き, no rendaku; cf. 広辞苑/大辞泉 きのみきのまま). The kana has ぎ for the second 着.

ops.current: kinomiginomamadekajikaranigeta.
ops.fix: kinomikinomamadekajikaranigeta.
ops.issue: Romaji propagates the same wrong reading of 着の身着のまま: 'kinomigi...' should be 'kinomiki...' (きのみきのまま).

ops.current: ぎ
ops.fix: き
ops.issue: Second 着 in 着の身着のまま is read き, not ぎ — the idiom has no rendaku (きのみきのまま). Token reading teaches a wrong pronunciation.

ops.current: É um uso muito comum em pt-BR equivalente a deixar a frase pendurada para soar educado.
ops.fix: É um uso muito comum, equivalente em pt-BR a deixar a frase pendurada para soar educado.
ops.full_before: A frase tem o foco gramatical na construção ですが. Aqui 茶色がいい significa literalmente 'o marrom é bom/melhor', e a partícula が marca 茶色 como o sujeito daquilo que é 'いい' (preferível). O ん (= の) antes de です dá um tom explicativo ('é que...'), e o が final é o が adversativo/atenuador: em vez de ligar a uma segunda oração, ele deixa a fala em aberto, suavizando o pedido ('eu queria o marrom, mas... [tudo bem?]'). É um uso muito comum em pt-BR equivalente a deixar a frase pendurada para soar educado.
ops.issue: Garbled clause: as written it says the Japanese usage is 'muito comum em pt-BR'. The en version says 'equivalent in English to leaving the sentence hanging'; the pt should read 'equivalente em pt-BR a...'.

ops.current: A forma negativa interrogativa (ませんか) suaviza e cortês o pedido.
ops.fix: A forma negativa interrogativa (ませんか) suaviza e torna o pedido mais cortês.
ops.full_before: A frase tem uma oração relativa: 地下鉄へ行く ('que vai para o metrô') modifica diretamente 道 (caminho), sem partícula entre o verbo 行く e o substantivo. 道 é o objeto marcado por を. O núcleo é 教えて + いただけませんか, um pedido bem polido: 〜ていただけませんか significa literalmente 'não poderia receber o favor de você ~?', isto é, 'você poderia ~?'. A forma negativa interrogativa (ませんか) suaviza e cortês o pedido.
ops.issue: Ungrammatical Portuguese: 'suaviza e cortês o pedido' is missing a verb (cortês is an adjective). The English version says 'softens and makes the request courteous'.

ops.current: requires a negative predicate (decshite～nai)
ops.fix: requires a negative predicate (kesshite～nai)
ops.issue: Typo in the English note of token 決して: 'decshite' should be the romanization 'kesshite' (the pt-BR note has it right).

ops.current: ぴたり is an onomatopoeia/mimetic word (giseigo) that describes something stopping abruptly and completely
ops.fix: ぴたり is a mimetic word (gitaigo) that describes something stopping abruptly and completely
ops.full_before: Although 'ぴたり' ends in 'り', it is not the 〜たり pattern (for listing actions): ぴたり is an onomatopoeia/mimetic word (giseigo) that describes something stopping abruptly and completely. The structure is 男は (topic) + ぴたりと (mimetic adverb with と) + 止まった (verb in the past).
ops.issue: ぴたり is mislabeled 'giseigo' (sound/voice mimetic). It describes a manner/state (stopping abruptly), so it is a gitaigo. Wrong classification taught to learners.

ops.current: ぴたり é uma onomatopeia/mímese (giseigo) que descreve algo parando seca e completamente

ops.issue: Same misclassification as expl_en: ぴたり é rotulada 'giseigo' (mimética de som/voz), mas é uma mímese de estado/maneira (gitaigo).

ops.current: 'food にうるさい' ('picky/fussy about food') is a quality
ops.fix: 食べ物にうるさい ('picky/fussy about food') is a quality
ops.full_before: The sentence classifies a subset and says it is small. 男の子で ('being a boy / in the case of boys') delimits the group; 'food にうるさい' ('picky/fussy about food') is a quality, and the の right after nominalizes that description, creating 'those who are picky about food'. This 'those who...' is marked as the topic by は, and the final predicate 少ない ('are few') comments on them. It is an N5 structure with nominalization and quantity contrast.
ops.issue: Corrupted Japanese quote: 'food にうるさい' substitutes the English word 'food' for 食べ物; the quote should reproduce the actual sentence text 食べ物にうるさい.

ops.current: 'food にうるさい' ('chato/exigente com a comida') é uma qualidade

ops.full_before: A frase classifica um subconjunto e diz que ele é pequeno. 男の子で ('sendo menino / no caso dos meninos') delimita o grupo; 'food にうるさい' ('chato/exigente com a comida') é uma qualidade, e o の logo depois nominaliza essa descrição, criando 'aqueles que são exigentes com a comida'. Esse 'os que...' é marcado como tópico por は, e o predicado final 少ない ('são poucos') comenta sobre eles. É uma estrutura de N5 com nominalização e contraste de quantidade.
ops.issue: The quoted Japanese phrase is corrupted: the English word 'food' appears in place of 食べ物 inside the pt-BR explanation ('food にうるさい'). Learners cannot match this quote to the sentence.

Structurally it is the fixed form derived from 済む + the polite auxiliary ます + the negation ん (済みません), but the beginner should memorize it whole (the target). The English hint 'to live' from the analyzer is incorrect; the correct root is 済む.

Estruturalmente é a forma fixa derivada de 済む + auxiliar polido ます + negação ん (済みません), mas o iniciante deve decorá-la inteira (o alvo/alvo). ops.current: The structure is 早く来れば (conditional "if you came early") + よかった ("it would have been good") + のに (regret).

ops.full_before: The focus is のに, which here appears at the end of the sentence with a tone of regret/reproach: ばよかった ("it would have been good if...") + のに means "you should have done it, but didn't" (regret over something that didn't happen). The structure is 早く来れば (conditional "if you came early") + よかった ("it would have been good") + のに (regret). It is the sentential のに of regret, not the mid-sentence connective.
ops.issue: The sentence actually says これば, a dialectal/nonstandard form (Tatoeba comments: Hyogo dialect; standard くれば). The expl silently rewrites it as standard 来れば, and the これ token note calls これ the 'conditional base of 来る' — false (the 仮定形 is くれ). As-is it teaches a wrong conjugation of 来る.

ops.current: A estrutura é 早く来れば (condicional "se viesse cedo") + よかった ("teria sido bom") + のに (lamento).

ops.full_before: O foco é のに, que aqui aparece no fim da frase com tom de lamento/recriminação: ばよかった ("teria sido bom se...") + のに significa "devia ter feito, mas não fez" (arrependimento de algo que não aconteceu). A estrutura é 早く来れば (condicional "se viesse cedo") + よかった ("teria sido bom") + のに (lamento). É o のに sentencial de pesar, não o conectivo de meio de frase.
ops.issue: Same as expl_en: the dialectal これば is presented without comment as standard 来れば; combined with the これ token note ('base condicional de 来る formando 来れば'), the record teaches learners that the conditional of 来る is これば instead of くれば. Token note must be fixed too.

ops.fix: é nominalizada por か+の antes de ように para dar 'como se soubesse de tudo'
ops.full_before: O foco é 〜のように, aqui na variante まるで〜かのように ('exatamente como se...'), usada para uma comparação irreal/hipotética. O advérbio まるで ('como se / exatamente') antecipa a comparação, e a oração 何でも知っている ('saber de tudo') é nominalizada por か+の antes de ようにに dar 'como se soubesse de tudo'. O verbo principal é 話す ('falar'), modificado adverbialmente por toda essa comparação.
ops.issue: Typo garbles the form: 'antes de ようにに dar' doubles に (could be read as part of the Japanese form) and drops 'para'; en version reads 'before ように to give'.

ops.current: Ainda, quanto a essa história, não estou ouvido (= não ouvi).
ops.fix: Ainda, quanto a essa história, não estou ouvindo (= não ouvi).
ops.issue: 'não estou ouvido' is ungrammatical Portuguese and reads as passive ('I am not heard'). The corpus mirrors ている with estar + gerúndio (cf. 'estivesse vendo'), so it should be 'ouvindo'.

ops.current: I, on the bed, lay on my side.
ops.fix: I, on the bed, became horizontal (= lay down).
ops.issue: 横になる = 'become horizontal / lie down', with no specification of lying on one's side; 'lay on my side' adds unsupported body orientation. lit_pt correctly mirrors it as 'na horizontal'.

ops.current: Da tarde de hoje, ao parque, não vamos? (convite)
ops.fix: Na tarde de hoje, ao parque, não vamos? (convite)
ops.issue: 'Da tarde de hoje' misrenders 今日の午後に: temporal に maps to 'na' (em+a), not 'da' (de+a); as written it reads 'from/of this afternoon'. Cf. item 1590863 where に is mirrored as 'na'.

ops.current: The structure is どうしたらいい abbreviated (どうしていい) + か (embedded question) + わからない ('I don't know')
ops.fix: The structure is どうしていい ('how it would be good to act'; equivalent in meaning to どうしたらいい) + か (embedded question) + わからない ('I don't know')
ops.full_before: Here どう ('how') and して are separate, within the expression どうしていいか ('what would be good to do / how to act'). It is not the interrogative どうして ('why'). The structure is どうしたらいい abbreviated (どうしていい) + か (embedded question) + わからない ('I don't know'), all embedded as the object of 'to not understand'.
ops.issue: False derivation claim: どうしていい is not an 'abbreviated' どうしたらいい; it is the て-form + いい construction ('how it would be OK to act'), merely equivalent in meaning. Also contradicts the し token note (て-form of する).

ops.current: A estrutura é どうしたらいい abreviada (どうしていい) + か (pergunta embutida) + わからない ('não sei')
ops.fix: A estrutura é どうしていい ('como seria bom agir'; equivalente em sentido a どうしたらいい) + か (pergunta embutida) + わからない ('não sei')
ops.full_before: Aqui どう ('como') e して são separados, dentro da expressão どうしていいか ('o que seria bom fazer / como agir'). Não é o interrogativo どうして ('por quê'). A estrutura é どうしたらいい abreviada (どうしていい) + か (pergunta embutida) + わからない ('não sei'), tudo encaixado como objeto de 'não entender'.
ops.issue: Same false derivation claim as expl_en: どうしていい is not どうしたらいい 'abreviada'; it is the て-form + いい pattern, only equivalent in meaning.

ops.current: bom dia(saudação matinal informal)
ops.fix: bom dia (saudação matinal informal)

ops.current: Eu quanto-a, logo, voltar-e-vir.

ops.current: soon, already, next
ops.fix: right away, soon

ops.current: As for me, this is the only thing I don't know (apart from this, I know everything).

ops.current: (element of the ～ものだ pattern: 'used to')
ops.fix: (past marker)

ops.current: nominalizador do padrão ～ものだ (recordação nostálgica)
ops.fix: auxiliar de tempo passado (た sonorizado em だ: 泳いだ)
ops.issue: Annotations shifted by one token. This だ (after 泳い) is the voiced past-tense auxiliary た of 泳いだ, not the nominalizer of ～ものだ (that is the following もの).

ops.current: it is (that's how it was)
ops.fix: thing (formal noun of ～ものだ: 'used to')
ops.issue: もの (a noun) is glossed as a copula ('it is'). The pt gloss 'é (era assim)' has the same swap and should become e.g. 'coisa (nominalizador de ～ものだ: costumava)'.

ops.current: cópula que fecha o padrão ～ものだ
ops.fix: substantivo formal (nominalizador) do padrão ～ものだ (recordação)
ops.issue: もの is labeled as the copula, but it is the formal noun/nominalizer of ～ものだ; the copula is the following だ token. Its note 'forma neutra da cópula だ' is also misplaced (it describes the final だ).

ops.current: Dentro da citação, 私は é o tópico
ops.fix: Na frase, 私は é o tópico (fora da citação)
ops.full_before: A frase usa a estrutura 〜と思う ('penso/acho que 〜'), em que a partícula と marca a oração citada 'テニスの試合に勝つ' como conteúdo do pensamento, e 思う ('pensar/achar') é o verbo principal. Dentro da citação, 私は é o tópico, きっと ('com certeza') é um advérbio que reforça a convicção, テニスの試合 ('partida de tênis') tem の ligando テニス a 試合, に marca o alvo do verbo, e 勝つ ('vencer') é o predicado da oração interna. O foco N4 é a citação de uma oração inteira com 〜と思う.
ops.issue: Self-contradiction: the explanation defines the quoted clause as テニスの試合に勝つ, then says 私は is 'dentro da citação'. 私は is the matrix topic, outside the quote. expl_en's 'Within: 私は topic' has the same slip.

ops.current: わたしわおじいさんのいえにいちどもおこなったことがない。

ops.current: watashiwaojiisannoieniichidomookonattakotoganai.

ops.current: Você é professor (esse fato eu sei.)
ops.fix: Você é professor (esse fato eu sei).

ops.current: watashiwayonjinidenwaokakenaosutsumoridesu.
ops.fix: watashiwayojinidenwaokakenaosutsumoridesu.

ops.fix: よ

ops.current: very (prefix)

ops.fix: watashinotanjoubiwaikkagetsusakinokyoudesu.

ops.current: As for my son, whatever it is, he wants to know it.
ops.fix: As for my child, whatever it is, he/she wants to know it.

ops.current: is by が (〜が必要だ treats the object of need as the grammatical subject. Predicate 必要である is the literary/written form of 必要だ.)

ops.issue: Garbled English: missing the word 'marked' ('is by が') and a misplaced opening parenthesis swallows the rest of the paragraph. The pt version is well-formed; the en should match it.

ops.current: それを ('this') is the object of the action: 'let ME do THIS'
ops.fix: それを ('that') is the object of the action: 'let ME do THAT'
ops.full_before: The focus is させてください ('let me do ~'). The verb する becomes the causative させる, and the request is made with 〜てください. 私に explicitly marks the person asking for permission ('to ME') and それを ('this') is the object of the action: 'let ME do THIS'.
ops.issue: それ is glossed as 'this' (これ = this); it should be 'that/it'. Contradicts the token gloss ('that') and expl_pt ('isso'), confusing for a course that teaches これ/それ.

ops.current: 副詞 ちょっと (um pouco) suaviza, e a partícula final よ acrescenta ênfase amigável.

ops.full_before: O alvo é 〜ほうがいい (é melhor / seria bom), usado para dar conselho. O verbo 休む (descansar) vem na forma passada 休んだ e é seguido de ほうがいい, padrão em que a forma passada do verbo + ほうがいい expressa recomendação. 副詞 ちょっと (um pouco) suaviza, e a partícula final よ acrescenta ênfase amigável.
ops.issue: Untranslated Japanese linguistic term 副詞 left in the learner-facing pt-BR explanation; the English version says 'The adverb'. Should be 'O advérbio'.

ops.current: にれいふんごとにばすがある。

ops.current: Quanto a eu pisar no pé (pata), o cachorro ganiu/gritou.

ops.current: The target is 'coverage' (general N4 review).
ops.fix: (remove this sentence)
ops.full_before: Here the highlight is the conditional/temporal particle と: 'whenever / when A happens, B happens'. The clause 私が足を踏む ('I step on the foot') is followed by と, and the natural result is 犬は鳴いた ('the dog yelped'). 私が uses が because it is the subject of a subordinate clause; 犬は uses は as the topic of the main clause. The target is 'coverage' (general N4 review).
ops.issue: Internal curriculum metadata leaked into learner-facing text: "The target is 'coverage' (general N4 review)." is meaningless jargon for a learner and should be deleted.

ops.current: O alvo é 'coverage' (revisão geral de N4).
ops.fix: (remover esta frase)

A oração 私が足を踏む ('eu piso no pé') é seguida de と, e o resultado natural é 犬は鳴いた ('o cachorro ganiu'). 私が usa が porque é o sujeito de uma oração subordinada; 犬は usa は por ser o tópico da oração principal. O alvo é 'coverage' (revisão geral de N4).
ops.issue: Same internal-metadata leak as expl_en: "O alvo é 'coverage'..." não é conteúdo didático e deve ser removido.

ops.current: In three days from now, I'll get up again.
ops.fix: In three days from now, (I) will raise (it) again.
