ops.current: The subject 私 is marked by が because it emphasizes the speaker within this subordinate stretch.
ops.fix: The subject 私 is marked by が because subjects of subordinate clauses (here the てから clause) take が rather than は.
ops.full_before: The focus is ～てから, which links the verb in the -て form (来て, 'to come') with the particle から to mean 'since / after'. Here it marks the starting point in time: 'since I came'. The second half 二年になる ('two years pass/are completed') uses なる ('to become') with に to indicate the amount of time that has accumulated. The subject 私 is marked by が because it emphasizes the speaker within this subordinate stretch.
ops.issue: Wrong rationale for が: in the てから subordinate clause が is the normal subordinate-subject marker, not a marker of emphasis on the speaker. As written it mis-teaches が as emphatic.

ops.current: O sujeito 私 é marcado por が porque dá ênfase ao falante dentro desse trecho subordinado.
ops.fix: O sujeito 私 é marcado por が porque sujeitos de orações subordinadas (como a de てから) levam が, não は.
ops.full_before: O foco é ～てから, que liga o verbo na forma -て (来て, 'vir') à partícula から para dizer 'desde que / depois de'. Aqui ele marca o ponto de partida no tempo: 'desde que eu vim'. A segunda metade 二年になる ('viram-se/completam-se dois anos') usa なる ('tornar-se') com に para indicar a quantidade de tempo que se acumulou. O sujeito 私 é marcado por が porque dá ênfase ao falante dentro desse trecho subordinado.
ops.issue: Same wrong rationale as expl_en: が na oração subordinada de てから é o marcador normal de sujeito subordinado, não ênfase no falante.

ops.current: to go out; to leave

ops.current: きのうきたるべきだったのに。

Core is 鳴らせ: base 鳴ら- takes the causative せ (of せる), forming 鳴らせ ('make it sound'), used as a command. Final よ reinforces the instruction. Note the parser treated 鳴ら as 鳴る + causative; in practice it equals the transitive 鳴らす ('to ring').
ops.issue: 鳴らせ is the imperative (命令形) of transitive 鳴らす plus emphatic particle よ — exactly the analysis sibling sentence 186677 gives. It is not stem + causative せ 'used as a command'; a bare causative stem cannot function as an imperative.

O núcleo é o verbo 鳴らせ: a base 鳴ら- recebe o sufixo causativo せ (de せる), formando 鳴らせ ('faça soar'), aqui usado como ordem. A frase termina com a partícula よ, que reforça a instrução. Observação: o analisador tratou 鳴ら como 鳴る + causativo; na prática equivale ao verbo transitivo 鳴らす ('fazer soar, tocar').

ops.current: The target is coverage, but the core structure is the past-habit construction with ものです.
ops.fix: (delete this sentence; end at '...which is the central point of the sentence.')
ops.full_before: The temporal setting comes first: 夏には ("in summer", with に of time reinforced by は of contrast/topic). Then その川に marks the destination (に = "to/at"), and 泳ぎに uses the stem of the verb 泳ぐ + に to indicate purpose ("in order to swim"). よく means "frequently", and 行った is "used to go/went". The closing 〜たものです expresses a recurring past habit ("used to do"), which is the central point of the sentence. The target is coverage, but the core structure is the past-habit construction with ものです.
ops.issue: Internal authoring note leaked into the learner-facing explanation: 'The target is coverage, but...' is corpus-build metadata, meaningless and confusing for learners.

ops.current: O alvo é cobertura, mas a estrutura nuclear é a construção de hábito passado com ものです.

Depois その川に marca o destino (に = "para/a"), e 泳ぎに usa a raiz do verbo 泳ぐ + に para indicar finalidade ("a fim de nadar"). よく significa "frequentemente", e 行った é "ia/foi". O fecho 〜たものです expressa um hábito recorrente do passado ("costumava fazer"), que é o ponto central da frase. O alvo é cobertura, mas a estrutura nuclear é a construção de hábito passado com ものです.

ops.current: The automatic segmentation joined あった+かい as if it were the adjective あったかい ('warm')

ops.full_before: The correct sentence is 何か + あった + かい. The automatic segmentation joined あった+かい as if it were the adjective あったかい ('warm'), but by meaning ('Is anything up?') it is 何か ('something') + あった (past of ある, 'to exist/there is/to happen') + the particle かい. かい is an informal and friendly question particle. Result: 'Did something happen?'.
ops.issue: Explanation exposes pipeline internals ('The automatic segmentation joined あった+かい...'). It should simply teach the parse and warn against confusing it with the adjective あったかい 'warm'.

ops.current: written entirely in hiragana and with a small spelling error (ひぎめ for 日極め)
ops.fix: Note: the original avoids kanji, writing ひぎめ for 日極め ('by the day') and かりられる for 借りられる.
ops.full_before: The topic is ロッジ (the lodge/cabin), marked by は. The expression 日極め (ひぎめ, 'by the day / daily') indicates the basis of the rental and takes で. The target is 〜られる (rareru) on the verb 借りる (to rent): かり + られる = 借りられる, here in the potential sense 'can be rented / is possible to rent.' Note: the original is written entirely in hiragana and with a small spelling error (ひぎめ for 日極め).
ops.issue: False orthography claim: ひぎめ IS the standard reading/kana spelling of 日極め (cf. 月極 つきぎめ), so there is no spelling error in the original — it is merely written in hiragana. The note teaches learners a nonexistent error.

O alvo é 〜られる (rareru) sobre o verbo 借りる (alugar): かり + られる = 借りられる, aqui no sentido potencial 'pode ser alugado / é possível alugar'. Observação: o original está escrito todo em hiragana e com pequeno erro de grafia (ひぎめ por 日極め).

ops.current: The target is coverage, practicing a color adjective + exclamation.
ops.fix: The sentence practices a color adjective inside an exclamation.
ops.full_before: This is an exclamatory sentence. It begins with なんと ("how...!", "what a...!"), which intensifies the admiration. The core is 空が青い ("the sky is/looks blue"), with 空 marked by が as the subject and 青い as an i-adjective. At the end, のだろう turns the sentence into a reflective/admiring exclamation: の (here a nominalizing/explanatory particle) followed by だろう (the presumptive form of だ), giving the tone of "how blue it is, isn't it!". The target is coverage, practicing a color adjective + exclamation.
ops.issue: Internal corpus-pipeline metadata leaked into the learner-facing explanation: 'The target is coverage' is meaningless to a learner ('coverage' is an internal selection category, not a grammar point).

ops.current: O alvo é cobertura (coverage), praticando adjetivo de cor + exclamação.

O núcleo é 空が青い ("o céu é/está azul"), com 空 marcado por が como sujeito e 青い como adjetivo-i. No fim, のだろう transforma a frase numa exclamação reflexiva/admirada: の (aqui partícula nominalizadora/explicativa) seguida de だろう (forma presuntiva de だ), dando o tom de "como é azul, não é mesmo!". O alvo é cobertura (coverage), praticando adjetivo de cor + exclamação.
ops.issue: Same internal-metadata leak as expl_en: 'O alvo é cobertura (coverage)' is pipeline jargon that means nothing to a learner.

ops.full_before: O padrão é どんな + N + にも = 'mesmo para qualquer N (não importa qual)'. Aqui どんな長い日にも = 'mesmo no mais longo dos dias'. O にも combina に (para/em) + も (até/mesmo), dando o sentido concessivo. O predicado 必ず終わりがある = 'sempre há um fim'.

The final particle か turns it all into a question. The target is どちらが, but note that there is NO complete scheme 'AとB、どちらが' (with two explicit options linked by と): here どちら appears alone.
ops.issue: どちら is labeled 'demonstrative'; it is an interrogative pronoun (ど- member of the kosoado series). expl_pt and the token role correctly say 'interrogativo', so expl_en is imprecise and inconsistent with expl_pt.

ops.current: Qual que (é) meu coisa é?

ops.current: Say which one you like.

ops.current: Where is it that we're going [nominalizer]-is [question]?

ops.current: The topic は marks 休み ('day off') as the subject
ops.fix: The topic particle は marks 休み ('day off') as the topic
ops.full_before: The sentence uses the target 〜たほうがいい: verb in the past form (とった, from とる 'to take/get') + ほう ('side/option') + が + いい ('good'), a construction that recommends an action, literally 'the option of having done it is better'. The topic は marks 休み ('day off') as the subject, and でも at the beginning means 'but/however'. The final particles わ and よ give a soft and emphatic tone, typical of informal female speech.
ops.issue: 休み is the topicalized OBJECT of とる, not the subject. expl_pt correctly says 'como o assunto' (topic); the English 'as the subject' reads as grammatical subject and teaches a false parse. Token role is correctly 'tópico'.

ops.current: funciona como substantivo/estado seguido da cópula だ ('é'), em vez do verbo する da frase anterior.
ops.fix: funciona como substantivo/estado seguido da cópula だ ('é').
ops.full_before: A frase abre com o cenário たいていの国では ('na maioria dos países'), onde の liga たいてい ('maioria') a 国 ('países'), で marca o local/âmbito e は o destaca como tópico de fundo. Depois 女性は ('quanto às mulheres') é o tópico principal. A comparação 男性より ('do que os homens') usa より como padrão. O predicado é 長生きだ, aqui 長生き ('longevidade') funciona como substantivo/estado seguido da cópula だ ('é'), em vez do verbo する da frase anterior.
ops.issue: Referência solta 'em vez do verbo する da frase anterior': o registro é autônomo, não existe 'frase anterior' para o aluno; vazamento de contexto de autoria. Same defect as expl_en.

ops.current: する becomes したら (conditional 〜たら) and follows どう ('how').
ops.fix: する becomes したら (conditional 〜たら) and is followed by どう ('how').
ops.full_before: Here the target 〜たらどう appears directly on the verb する ('to do'). The noun ダイエット ('diet') combines with する to form 'to diet'; する becomes したら (conditional 〜たら) and follows どう ('how'). The sense is a suggestion: 'and if you dieted, how about it?'. The final だ is the informal copula, giving the tone of casual advice.
ops.issue: Says したら 'follows どう', inverting the actual order: in ダイエットしたらどうだ, したら precedes どう (pattern 〜たらどう). Misleading order description of the target construction; should be 'is followed by どう'.

ops.current: する vira したら (condicional 〜たら) e segue どう ('como').

O substantivo ダイエット ('dieta') combina com する para formar 'fazer dieta'; する vira したら (condicional 〜たら) e segue どう ('como'). O sentido é uma sugestão: 'e se você fizesse dieta, que tal?'. O だ final é a cópula informal, dando o tom de conselho casual.
ops.issue: Diz que したら 'segue どう', invertendo a ordem real: したら vem antes de どう no padrão 〜たらどう. Same inverted-order slip as expl_en; should read 'é seguido de どう'.

ops.current: その階段 (here その + restaurant) is the topic marked by は

ops.full_before: Basic location structure: topic + に + ある ('to exist / be located'). その階段 (here その + restaurant) is the topic marked by は; 1階 ('1st floor') is the place marked by に; ある indicates the existence/location of an inanimate thing. In Japan, 1階 corresponds to the ground floor. The target is N5 coverage; focus on 〜に + ある to say where something is located.

No Japão, 1階 corresponde ao térreo. O alvo é cobertura N5; foque em 〜に + ある para dizer onde algo fica.

The sentence has a temporal clause (この次に来るとき = 'next time you come') followed by the request 持ってきてくれ ('bring it'), which combines 持つ + てくる ('to bring along') with くれ, the informal imperative of くれる used to ask a favor of the speaker.
ops.issue: Benefactive direction inverted: 'ask a favor of the speaker' means requesting the favor FROM the speaker. くれ asks the LISTENER to do something for the speaker's benefit.

ops.current: usada para pedir um favor a quem fala

ops.full_before: Atenção: aqui aparece この次に ("da próxima vez"), formado pelo demonstrativo この + 次 + に, e NÃO o padrão-alvo 〜の次に (substantivo + の + 次に). Por isso o ponto gramatical-alvo não se aplica de verdade. A frase tem uma oração temporal (この次に来るとき = "na próxima vez que vier") seguida do pedido 持ってきてくれ ("traga"), que combina 持つ + てくる ("trazer consigo") com くれ, forma imperativa informal de くれる usada para pedir um favor a quem fala.

ops.current: e 思い出します ('me faço lembrar') é o resultado

ops.full_before: O ponto central é o と condicional: 聞くと significa 'sempre que/quando ouço', indicando que um fato leva naturalmente a outro. A oração この歌を聞く ('ouço esta música') é a condição, e 思い出します ('me faço lembrar') é o resultado. 私の中学校時代 ('minha época do ginásio') é o objeto lembrado, marcado por を; 私の usa の para indicar posse e 中学校時代 junta 中学校 (escola média) + 時代 (época). O verbo está na forma polida -ます, então a tradução mantém um tom neutro/educado.
ops.issue: 'me faço lembrar' is not acceptable Brazilian Portuguese for 思い出します ('I recall'); expl_en correctly says 'I remember'. Should be 'lembro / me lembro'.

ops.current: (it is an emphatic and slightly formal/lively invitation: 'come on, what do you say we sing?'. The object
ops.fix: Close after "we sing?'" -> "...what do you say we sing?'). The object 歌 is marked by を, and 歌おう is the volitional of 歌う. The grammatical focus じゃないか here reinforces and energizes the proposal." (delete the trailing stray ')')
ops.full_before: This sentence uses 〜じゃないか in a special use: after the volitional form of the verb (歌おう, 'let's sing'). The combination 〜(よ)うじゃないか is neither negation nor a real question (it is an emphatic and slightly formal/lively invitation: 'come on, what do you say we sing?'. The object 歌 is marked by を, and 歌おう is the volitional of 歌う. The grammatical focus じゃないか here reinforces and energizes the proposal.)
ops.issue: Unbalanced parentheses: '(' opens mid-sentence and only closes at the very end after 'proposal.', swallowing two full sentences. Close after "sing?'" and delete the stray ')' at the end.

ops.current: (é um convite enfático e levemente formal/animado: 'vamos lá, que tal cantarmos?'. O objeto

A combinação 〜(よ)うじゃないか não é negação nem pergunta de verdade (é um convite enfático e levemente formal/animado: 'vamos lá, que tal cantarmos?'. O objeto 歌 é marcado por を, e 歌おう é a forma volitiva de 歌う. O foco gramatical じゃないか aqui reforça e dá energia à proposta.)
ops.issue: Same unbalanced parenthesis as expl_en: '(' opens at 'é um convite' and only closes after 'proposta.' at the end. Close after 'cantarmos?' and delete the final stray ')'.

ops.current: Note: at the start appears a この は probably truncated, but the reading is 'this box'.
ops.fix: Note: このはこの is この箱(はこ)の — 'of this box': はこ (box) written in hiragana, followed by genitive の.
ops.full_before: Contrastive sentence linked by が ('but'). The first part says that 外 ('the outside') is 緑 (green) with the copula だ; the second says that 中 ('the inside') is 赤 (red), here with the formal/written copula である (variant of だ/です). The several は mark the contrasts (outside vs. inside). Note: at the start appears a この は probably truncated, but the reading is 'this box'.
ops.issue: False grammar claim: says a 'この は probably truncated' appears at the start. Nothing is truncated — このはこの is この箱の ('of this box'): はこ = 箱 in hiragana + genitive の. Also inconsistent with expl_pt, which gives a different (equally wrong) parse.

ops.current: No início, このは corresponde a この箱は ('quanto a esta caixa'), com は marcando o tópico.
ops.fix: No início, このはこの corresponde a この箱の ('desta caixa'): はこ é 箱 (caixa) em hiragana, seguido do の genitivo.
ops.full_before: Frase contrastiva ligada por が ('mas'). A primeira parte diz que 外 ('o lado de fora') é 緑 (verde) com a cópula だ; a segunda diz que 中 ('o de dentro') é 赤 (vermelho), aqui com a cópula formal/escrita である (variante de だ/です). Os vários は marcam os contrastes (fora vs. dentro). No início, このは corresponde a この箱は ('quanto a esta caixa'), com は marcando o tópico.
ops.issue: False grammar claim: says このは = この箱は with は marking topic. Actually このはこ = この箱 and the following の is the genitive ('desta caixa'); the clause-1 topic は comes only after 外. Teaches a wrong parse of the sentence.

ops.current: このわこのそとわみどりだがちゅうわあかである。

ops.fix: なか
ops.issue: Standalone 中 'the inside (of the box)' is read なか; ちゅう is the on-reading used only in compounds/suffixes, not for the bare noun contrasted with 外 (そと).

ops.current: The! and the blunt imperative give a tone of order/irritation.
ops.fix: The exclamation mark (!) and the blunt imperative give a tone of order/irritation.
ops.full_before: ぐずぐず is a mimetic adverb describing dawdling/dragging one's feet. With する it becomes ぐずぐずする ('to keep dawdling'), here in ～ずに: せ + ず + に = 'without dawdling.' The final command is 早くしろ ('do it quickly'): 早く (adverbial form of 早い) + しろ (imperative of する). The! and the blunt imperative give a tone of order/irritation.
ops.issue: Missing space/word makes 'The!' read as an interjection; the sentence refers to the exclamation mark.

ops.current: O! e o imperativo bruto dão tom de ordem/irritação.
ops.fix: O ponto de exclamação (!) e o imperativo bruto dão tom de ordem/irritação.
ops.full_before: ぐずぐず é um advérbio (mimético) que descreve enrolar/demorar. Com する vira ぐずぐずする ('ficar enrolando'), aqui em ～ずに: せ + ず + に = 'sem enrolar'. O comando final é 早くしろ ('faça rápido'): 早く (forma adverbial de 早い) + しろ (imperativo de する). O! e o imperativo bruto dão tom de ordem/irritação.
ops.issue: Mesmo problema do expl_en: 'O!' lê-se como interjeição; falta a palavra para o ponto de exclamação.

ops.current: The main clause は私たち...知った says "we found out."
ops.fix: The main clause 私たちは...知った says "we found out."
ops.full_before: The core is ～てはじめて: なって (te-form of なる, "to come to/become") + はじめて ("for the first time") expresses "it was only after arriving yesterday that...". The main clause は私たち...知った says "we found out." それについて = "about it" (について functions as the phrase "with regard to," although the tokenizer broke off つい as a verb).
ops.issue: Quoted Japanese garbled: topic particle written before the pronoun ('は私たち'); should be 私たちは.

ops.current: A oração principal は私たち...知った diz "nós soubemos".
ops.fix: A oração principal 私たちは...知った diz "nós soubemos".
ops.full_before: O núcleo é ～てはじめて: なって (forma て de なる, "chegar a/tornar-se") + はじめて ("pela primeira vez") expressa "foi só depois de chegar ontem que...". A oração principal は私たち...知った diz "nós soubemos". それについて = "sobre isso" (について funciona como locução "a respeito de", apesar de o tokenizador ter quebrado つい como verbo).
ops.issue: Same garbled quote as expl_en: 'は私たち' should be 私たちは.

ops.current: Como é frase de cobertura, ela prática から temporal + 〜ている
ops.fix: Como é frase de cobertura, ela pratica から temporal + 〜ている
ops.full_before: O tópico é お父さんは ('o pai/meu pai'). 今朝から usa から ('desde') para marcar o ponto de partida no tempo ('desde hoje de manhã'), e o advérbio ずっと reforça a continuidade ('sem parar, o tempo todo'). O verbo está em 洗っている (forma 〜ている de 洗う, 'lavar'), indicando uma ação em curso/contínua. Como é frase de cobertura, ela prática から temporal + 〜ている para 'vir fazendo algo desde...'.

ops.current: Quality tea [topic] is in the process of going down.
ops.fix: The quality of the tea [topic] is in the process of going down.
ops.issue: Genitive reversed: お茶の質 is 'the quality of the tea' (head = 質), but 'Quality tea' means high-grade tea, flipping modifier and head. Contradicts en/pt/expl and misteaches の structure in the structural-mirror field.

ops.current: Chá de qualidade [tópico] descendo está-em-processo.
ops.fix: A qualidade do chá [tópico] descendo está-em-processo.

ops.current: é um substantivo cuja última sílaba é 当たり
ops.fix: é um substantivo que termina em 当たり
ops.full_before: O foco alvo era 〜たりする, mas ele NÃO aparece aqui. 八つ当たり ('descontar/descarregar a raiva em quem não tem culpa') é um substantivo cuja última sílaba é 当たり; o 'たり' faz parte dessa palavra, não da gramática de listagem. A estrutura real é 八つ当たり + する ('fazer/cometer um 八つ当たり') + な (proibição) + よ (ênfase): 'não desconte em mim!'.
ops.issue: Terminology error: 当たり (あたり, três moras) não é uma 'sílaba'; é o elemento final do substantivo 八つ当たり. A afirmação pedagógica está certa, mas o rótulo linguístico é falso.

ops.current: 気前よく（'generously, willingly') is an adverb describing how he gives the money.
ops.fix: 気前よく ('generously, willingly') is an adverb describing how he gives the money.
ops.full_before: A typical topic-comment structure: おじは ('as for the uncle') is the topic, and 金を出す ('to put out/give money') is what is said about him. The target 出す is the full verb 'to take out/spend (money)', and NOT the auxiliary 〜出す ('to start to'). 気前よく（'generously, willingly') is an adverb describing how he gives the money.
ops.issue: Mismatched parentheses: full-width （ opened but closed with ASCII ), leaving a stray bracket in the learner-facing text.

ops.current: 気前よく（'generosamente, de boa vontade') é um advérbio que descreve como ele dá o dinheiro.
ops.fix: 気前よく ('generosamente, de boa vontade') é um advérbio que descreve como ele dá o dinheiro.
ops.full_before: Estrutura típica tópico–comentário: おじは ('quanto ao tio') é o tópico, e 金を出す ('desembolsar/dar dinheiro') é o que se diz dele. O alvo 出す é o verbo pleno 'tirar/desembolsar (dinheiro)', e NÃO o auxiliar 〜出す ('começar a'). 気前よく（'generosamente, de boa vontade') é um advérbio que descreve como ele dá o dinheiro.
ops.issue: Mismatched parentheses: full-width （ opened but closed with ASCII ), leaving a stray bracket in the learner-facing text.

ops.current: They're all fine, thank you.
ops.fix: I'm doing well, thank you.

ops.current: O foco aqui é coverage (vocabulário e estrutura básica de pergunta/resposta)
ops.fix: O foco aqui é cobertura (vocabulário e estrutura básica de pergunta/resposta)
ops.full_before: Este é um diálogo curto entre aspas japonesas (「 」). Na primeira fala, この店は marca "esta loja" como tópico (com a partícula は) e 初めて ("primeira vez") fecha a pergunta sem verbo explícito, apenas com entonação de pergunta marcada por ？. Na resposta, ええ é um "sim" coloquial e 初めてです repete "é a primeira vez" agora com a cópula です para dar tom educado. O foco aqui é coverage (vocabulário e estrutura básica de pergunta/resposta), e a frase mostra como o japonês frequentemente omite o verbo quando o contexto deixa claro.
ops.issue: English word 'coverage' left untranslated in the pt-BR explanation; elsewhere in the corpus it is rendered 'cobertura' (cf. sent:tatoeba-228248).

ops.current: As for the mother of the house (topic), the person next door (subject) doesn't like very much (negation).
ops.fix: As for the mother of the house (topic), the person next door (subject) is not liked very much (negation).

ops.current: うちのいぬわいちにちちゅうひなたによこになっている。

ops.current: uchinoinuwaichinichichuuhinataniyokoninatteiru.
ops.fix: uchinoinuwaichinichijuuhinataniyokoninatteiru.

ops.fix: じゅう
ops.issue: The suffix 中 'throughout' rendaku-voices after 一日: いちにちじゅう. ちゅう is the 'in the middle of doing' suffix (電話中, 会議中), not the reading in 一日中.

ops.current: Quanto ao cachorro da nossa casa, o dia inteiro, ao sol, está se tornando deitado.
ops.fix: Quanto ao cachorro da nossa casa, o dia inteiro, ao sol, está deitado.

ops.current: When does it end? (right?)
ops.fix: When is it that it ends?
ops.issue: The parenthetical '(right?)' glosses final の as a confirmation tag — that is ね, not の. Sentence-final の here is the casual/explanatory question particle (as expl_en itself states), and a wh-question cannot take 'right?'.

ops.current: Quando termina(r)? (né?)
ops.fix: Quando é que termina?
ops.issue: '(né?)' equates の with the tag ね ('não é?'); here の is the casual/explanatory question particle, so the gloss teaches the wrong particle mapping. Mirror it with 'é que' (the same device the corpus uses for のですか, cf. sent:tatoeba-228648).

ops.current: verbo (raiz de 言い切れない)
ops.fix: verbo da oração concessiva (お礼を言っても)
ops.issue: This 言っ is the main verb of the concessive clause お礼を言っても; it is not the root of 言い切れない (that is the separate 言い / 言い切れ tokens). The role even contradicts the token's own note ('forma て de 言う, ligada a も para formar 〜ても').

ops.current: He doesn't seem like a good person, does he?
ops.fix: He seems like a good person, doesn't he? (じゃないか = confirmation, not negation)
ops.issue: じゃないか here is rhetorical confirmation ('right?/don't you think?'), exactly as the expl states; this English tag question instead asserts he is NOT a good person — the opposite polarity of the JP (en/pt/expl all say he seems good).

ops.current: い form (renyōkei) of なる, linking to た

ops.issue: なっ before た is the sokuonbin (促音便, geminate euphonic change) of the renyōkei of なる — not an 'い form'. Both the en and pt-BR notes carry the wrong label (apparently copied from the 聞い token, where 'い form' is correct).

ops.current: クビにする ('to put around the neck') is an idiom for 'to fire,'

ops.full_before: The condition is そんなことしたら ('if you do such a thing'), formed by the verb する in the conditional form たら. It is not the pattern としたら (there is no と before it), but rather the simple conditional 〜たら. クビにする ('to put around the neck') is an idiom for 'to fire,' and からな closes with a tone of warning/threat.
ops.issue: Wrong literal reading of the idiom: クビにする is Xにする 'to make [someone] into a neck' (beheading metaphor), not 'to put around the neck'. Misidentifies the にする construction.

ops.current: クビにする ('pôr no pescoço') é uma expressão idiomática para 'demitir'

ops.issue: Same wrong literal reading in Portuguese: 'pôr no pescoço' treats に as locative; the construction is Xにする = 'tornar [alguém] pescoço'.

ops.current: Note that with ごろ the time particle に is not used, since ごろ itself already fulfills that role.
ops.fix: Note that after ごろ the particle に is optional (６時ごろに起きた is also correct); here it is simply omitted.
ops.full_before: Here the grammar focus ごろ ('around') appears in a typical way: 6時 (six o'clock) + ごろ marks an approximate time and functions as the time adjunct of the verb. The verb is 起きた, the simple past of 起きる ('to get up / wake up'): stem 起き + past auxiliary た. Note that with ごろ the time particle に is not used, since ごろ itself already fulfills that role.
ops.issue: False absolute rule: に is optional after ごろ, not banned — ６時ごろに起きた is perfectly correct and textbook-standard. As written it teaches a nonexistent prohibition.

ops.current: Note que com ごろ não se usa a partícula に de tempo, pois o próprio ごろ já cumpre esse papel.
ops.fix: Note que depois de ごろ a partícula に é opcional (６時ごろに起きた também é correto); aqui ela foi apenas omitida.
ops.full_before: Aqui o foco gramatical ごろ ('por volta de') aparece de forma típica: 6時 (seis horas) + ごろ marca um horário aproximado e funciona como adjunto de tempo do verbo. O verbo é 起きた, passado simples de 起きる ('levantar-se / acordar'): raiz 起き + auxiliar た de passado. Note que com ごろ não se usa a partícula に de tempo, pois o próprio ごろ já cumpre esse papel.
ops.issue: Same false rule in Portuguese: に after ごろ is optional, not proibida — ６時ごろに起きた é correto.

ops.current: Note: the たり in 一人 is just part of the word, not the 〜たり〜たり pattern.
ops.fix: Note: the たり in あたり is just part of the word, not the 〜たり〜たり pattern.
ops.full_before: Points to a place (このあたり = 'around here') marked by に, with topic は. The subject そんな名前の人 (a person with that name) is taken up; the key point is 一人も … ない: 一人 (one person) + も (not even) + negation ない = 'not a single person', emphatic negation. Note: the たり in 一人 is just part of the word, not the 〜たり〜たり pattern.
ops.issue: False claim: 一人 (ひとり) contains no たり. The たり string occurs in あたり (このあたり), which is clearly what the disclaimer meant; as written it confuses learners about the reading of 一人.

ops.current: Atenção: o たり que aparece em 一人 ('uma pessoa') é só parte da palavra, não o padrão 〜たり〜たり.

ops.full_before: A frase aponta um lugar (このあたり = 'esta redondeza/por aqui') marcado por に, e usa o tópico は para falar a respeito deste lugar. O sujeito そんな名前の人 (pessoa com esse nome) é retomado e o ponto-chave é 一人も … ない: a combinação de 一人 (uma pessoa) + も (nem) + a negação ない significa 'nem uma única pessoa', uma negação enfática. Atenção: o たり que aparece em 一人 ('uma pessoa') é só parte da palavra, não o padrão 〜たり〜たり.
ops.issue: Same false claim as expl_en: 一人 (ひとり) does not contain たり; the string たり is in あたり. As written it implies a wrong reading of 一人.

ops.current: The target is N4 coverage.
ops.fix: (delete this sentence)

The core is 連絡してない (the colloquial form of 連絡していない = 'to not be in touch/contact'), where 連絡する (to get in contact) is in the 〜ている form contracted to 〜てる and then negated (〜てない). This negative form becomes 〜なくて to link to the final apology ごめんね. The ね at the end is a soft particle seeking empathy, like 'okay?/you know?'. The target is N4 coverage.

ops.current: O alvo é cobertura N4.

Essa forma negativa vira 〜なくて para ligar à desculpa final ごめんね. O ね no fim é uma partícula suave que busca empatia, como 'tá?/viu?'. O alvo é cobertura N4.

ops.current: the object particle を and the particle が have been omitted
ops.fix: the object particle を and the topic particle は (after の) have been omitted
ops.full_before: The clause 最後に髪切った ('cut one's hair last') is nominalized by the particle の (準体助詞), which functions as 'the time/the moment when...'. This block becomes the subject, and the predicate is いつですか ('is when?'). It is a colloquial question: the object particle を and the particle が have been omitted, as is common in speech. Meaning: 'When was the last time (you) cut your hair?'.
ops.issue: Wrong particle restoration: the full form is 最後に髪を切ったのはいつですか — the particle omitted after nominalizer の is topic は, not が (のがいつですか is unnatural as a direct question). Teaching learners to restore が here is misleading.

Esse bloco vira o sujeito, e o predicado é いつですか ('é quando?'). É uma pergunta coloquial: a partícula を de objeto e a partícula が foram omitidas, como é comum na fala. Sentido: 'Quando foi a última vez que (você) cortou o cabelo?'.

ops.full_before: The sentence is a single interjection (感動詞), こんにちは, the general greeting used during the day (from mid-morning to late afternoon), equivalent to 'hello' or 'good afternoon'. For the beginner, however, it is best to memorize it whole as an apology formula (the target of the sentence). Note: the English hint from the analyzer ('to live') is wrong; the root is 済む, not 住む.

ops.current: We take the verb 書く/かく (here かく in the sense of 'to snore', いびきをかく = 'to snore')

ops.full_before: This sentence uses the target 〜たことがある, the pattern that expresses past experience ('I have done it at some time'). We take the verb 書く/かく (here かく in the sense of 'to snore', いびきをかく = 'to snore'), put it in the past form かいた and add ことがある, literally 'there is the thing of having done'. The が marks こと (the experience) as the subject of ある ('to exist/there is'). The rising intonation of the ？ turns it all into an informal question.
ops.issue: The verb of いびきをかく is misidentified as 書く ('to write'). The idiom uses かく = 掻く (normally written in kana), not 書く. This teaches a false verb/kanji identity to learners.

O が marca こと (a experiência) como sujeito de ある ('existir/haver'). A entonação ascendente do ？ transforma tudo em pergunta informal.

A partícula final と liga essa oração ao verbo 思う ('achar'). Como a frase é uma pergunta (？), o sentido é 'o que você acha que eu estava fazendo?'.

ops.current: Note that there is no だ before かい because 同じ functions as the predicate.

The grammatical target is the final particle かい, which here appears as か + い together (かい): it is an informal and gentle way of asking a yes/no question, typical of masculine speech or of speaking with someone close. Note that there is no だ before かい because 同じ functions as the predicate.
ops.issue: Wrong reason for the missing copula: だ is absent because plain だ is regularly dropped before か/かい after any noun/na-adjective, not because 同じ 'functions as the predicate' (as a plain statement it would be 同じだ).

ops.current: なかった (past of ない, "to not exist") + たら = なかったら

The main clause is 生きていけない, a combination of 生きる + ていく (living "going forward") in the negative potential いけない ("I can't live"). よ at the end asserts the idea with emphasis to the listener.
ops.issue: Morphology formula double-counts た: 'なかった + たら' would yield *なかったたら. Correct segmentation is なかっ + たら (matching the token split なかっ|たら) or なかった + ら.

A oração principal é 生きていけない, junção de 生きる + ていく (viver "indo adiante") na forma potencial negativa いけない ("não consigo viver"). よ no fim afirma a ideia com ênfase ao ouvinte.

ops.current: O foco é só cobertura (coverage), com destaque ao padrão de ir com propósito.

ops.current: explanatory の + the emphatic feminine particle よ

ops.full_before: The sentence opens with the colloquial apology ごめんね (sorry + the final particle ね, which seeks understanding). Then 明日は marks 'tomorrow' as the topic (は), and 朝から means 'from the morning on' (から = starting point). The core is パートがある ('there is a part-time job'), with が marking what exists. The ending のよ is the combination of explanatory の + the emphatic feminine particle よ, giving the tone of someone justifying something to the listener.
ops.issue: よ itself is gender-neutral; the feminine coloring belongs to the combination のよ. Calling よ 'the emphatic feminine particle' teaches a false generalization about よ.

O final のよ é a combinação explicativa の + a partícula ênfatica feminina よ, dando o tom de quem justifica algo ao interlocutor.
ops.issue: Same defect as expl_en (よ is neutral; the feminine coloring is in the combination のよ), plus spelling error 'ênfatica' (correct: 'enfática').

ops.current: Since こと is preceded by a noun/nominalized predicate, だ becomes な before のです
ops.fix: Since the predicate ends in the noun こと, the copula takes the form な before のです
ops.full_before: The target is こと functioning as an abstract noun ('thing', 'matter'). The clause 話せば ('if (I) tell', the conditional ~ば form of 話す) and the adjective 長い ('long') modify こと: 'a thing that, if told, is long'. Since こと is preceded by a noun/nominalized predicate, だ becomes な before のです, and のです gives an explanatory tone ('it's that...').
ops.issue: Garbled rule: こと is not 'preceded by a noun' here (it is preceded by the i-adjective 長い). だ becomes な before のです because こと itself is a noun ending the predicate.

ops.current: Como こと é precedido por um substantivo/predicado nominalizado, o だ vira な antes de のです

ops.full_before: O foco é こと funcionando como substantivo abstrato ('coisa', 'assunto'). A oração 話せば ('se (eu) contar', forma condicional ~ば de 話す) e o adjetivo 長い ('longo') modificam こと: 'uma coisa que, se for contada, é longa'. Como こと é precedido por um substantivo/predicado nominalizado, o だ vira な antes de のです, e のです dá tom explicativo ('é que...').
ops.issue: Same garbled rule in Portuguese: こと não é precedido por substantivo (é precedido pelo adjetivo 長い); o な aparece porque こと é substantivo.

ops.current: The target particle is こと, the nominalizer.
ops.fix: The target is こと, a formal noun used as a nominalizer.
ops.full_before: The target particle is こと, the nominalizer. Here it appears twice: 話すこと ('the act of speaking') and 書くこと ('the act of writing'), turning each verb into a noun. The two noun groups are linked by と ('and'), and the whole becomes the topic with は, ending in 別物だ ('is/are a different thing/things').
ops.issue: こと is not a particle; it is a formal noun used as a nominalizer. Calling it 'the target particle' teaches a wrong word class (the token role itself correctly says nominalizer).

ops.current: A partícula-alvo é こと, o nominalizador.

Os dois grupos nominais são ligados por と ("e"), e o conjunto vira tópico com は, encerrando em 別物だ ("é/são coisa(s) diferente(s)").
ops.issue: Same miscategorization in Portuguese: こと is a substantivo formal (nominalizador), not a partícula.

ops.current: The subject is 何十万人もの人 ('tens of thousands of people')

ops.full_before: The sentence opens with 来週になると ('when next week comes'): なる ('to become') + the particle と forms a natural temporal conditional ('when/upon coming'). The subject is 何十万人もの人 ('tens of thousands of people'), where も emphasizes the large quantity and の links the number to the noun 人. The core is 見ている (to see + to be = 'to be watching'), and だろう at the end expresses probability/prediction ('probably, must be'). Note the two 人: the first (にん) is the counter suffix for people within the number, the second (ひと) is the noun 'people.'

O sujeito é 何十万人もの人 ('dezenas de milhares de pessoas'), onde も dá ênfase à grande quantidade e の liga o número ao substantivo 人. O núcleo é 見ている (ver + estar = 'estar assistindo'), e だろう no fim expressa probabilidade/previsão ('provavelmente, deve estar'). Note os dois 人: o primeiro (にん) é o sufixo contador de pessoas dentro do número, o segundo (ひと) é o substantivo 'pessoas'.
ops.issue: Explanation glosses 何十万人もの人 as 'dezenas de milhares de pessoas'; 何十万 = centenas de milhares. Contradicts the pt translation itself ('centenas de milhares').

ops.current: the sentence ends without a verb, leaving そのつもりで implicit ('...so keep that expectation')
ops.fix: the sentence ends without a verb: what is left implicit is the verb after そのつもりで (e.g. いてください), '...so keep that expectation'
ops.full_before: Although つもり appears, here it is NOT the grammatical construction 'verb + つもり = intention to do'. つもり is used as a common noun modified by the demonstrative その ('that idea/expectation'), in the fixed expression そのつもりで 'count on it / keep that in mind'. The first part 明日行くから ('because I'm going tomorrow') uses から as a causal conjunction, and the sentence ends without a verb, leaving そのつもりで implicit ('...so keep that expectation').
ops.issue: States that そのつもりで is 'implicit', but そのつもりで is explicitly present in the sentence; what is implicit is the verb AFTER it (e.g. いてください). As written the claim contradicts the visible sentence.

ops.current: a frase termina sem verbo, deixando そのつもりで implícito ('...fique nessa expectativa')

ops.full_before: Apesar de つもり aparecer, aqui ele NÃO é a construção gramatical 'verbo + つもり = intenção de fazer'. つもり é usado como substantivo comum modificado pelo demonstrativo その ('essa ideia/expectativa'), na expressão fixa そのつもりで 'conte com isso / tenha isso em mente'. A primeira parte 明日行くから ('porque vou amanhã') usa から como conjunção de causa, e a frase termina sem verbo, deixando そのつもりで implícito ('...fique nessa expectativa').
ops.issue: Mesma falha da versão em inglês: diz que そのつもりで fica 'implícito', mas ele está explícito na frase; o implícito é o verbo depois dele (ex.: いてください).

ops.current: The target is N4 coverage.
ops.fix: Remove the final sentence 'The target is N4 coverage.'
ops.full_before: The heart of the sentence is the concessive construction 〜ても ('even if / even though'): the verb する ('to do') in the te-form (して) + the particle も form 失敗しても = 'even if (I) fail'. At the start, 万一 (まんいち) is an adverb that reinforces the remote hypothesis, 'in the unlikely event of / if by any chance'. The second part, もう一度がんばります, brings もう一度 ('once more') + がんばる ('to do one's best') in the polite ます form, expressing the speaker's resolve. The target is N4 coverage.

ops.current: O alvo é coverage de N4.

No começo, 万一 (まんいち) é um advérbio que reforça a hipótese remota, 'na remota hipótese de / se por acaso'. A segunda parte, もう一度がんばります, traz もう一度 ('mais uma vez') + がんばる ('esforçar-se') na forma polida ます, expressando a resolução do falante. O alvo é coverage de N4.

ops.full_before: 「僕のかわりに」 uses 「～のかわりに」 (in place of / for), with の linking the pronoun 僕 (I) to かわり: 'in my place'. The central verb 「とって」 (to fetch, in the て-form of とる) takes the auxiliary 「くれる」, which marks a favor done for the speaker. The ending 「ませんか」 turns it all into a polite request (negative + か = invitation/polite request).
ops.issue: expl_en glosses とって as 'to fetch', a wrong sense for 電話をとる (answer/take a call); expl_pt correctly says 'atender', so the two versions are inconsistent.

ops.current: Existence sentence with ある ('there is', for inanimate things). The place is the topic, and the item that exists is marked by が
ops.fix: Command with the 〜なさい form, a firm but polite imperative. 帽子を marks the direct object; かぶる ('wear on the head') appears as stem かぶり + なさい.
ops.full_before: Existence sentence with ある ('there is', for inanimate things). The place is the topic, and the item that exists is marked by が; the verb ある affirms its existence. It follows the basic location pattern [place に] [thing が] ある.
ops.issue: expl_en describes a completely different sentence (an existence sentence with ある and the [place に][thing が]ある pattern). The actual sentence is a 〜なさい imperative; expl_pt describes it correctly, so the two versions contradict each other. Copy-paste error teaching false grammar.

ops.current: Como é um adjetivo-i no plano (古い), a frase está em estilo informal/neutro.
ops.fix: Como é um adjetivo-i na forma plana (古い), a frase está em estilo informal/neutro.
ops.full_before: Esta é a construção de duplo sujeito "A は B が + adjetivo": 母 (mãe) é o tópico com は, e dentro do comentário 頭 (cabeça) é o sujeito marcado por が, descrito pelo adjetivo-i 古い (velho). A expressão 頭が古い é idiomática: literalmente "a cabeça é velha", significa "ter mentalidade ultrapassada/antiquada". Como é um adjetivo-i no plano (古い), a frase está em estilo informal/neutro.
ops.issue: 'adjetivo-i no plano' drops the word 'forma' (expl_en: 'in the plain form'); 'no plano' reads as 'in the plane/plan' and is not the established term.

ops.current: I made conversation until my heart was emptied (satisfied).
ops.fix: I made conversation until my heart was content (fully satisfied).
ops.issue: 心ゆく (heart 行く 'to go/reach contentment') rendered literally as 'heart was emptied'. ゆく never means 'to empty'; contradicts expl_en, which correctly says 'the heart to be content'.

ops.current: Eu, até o coração se esvaziar (ficar satisfeito), fiz conversa.
ops.fix: Eu, até o coração se contentar (ficar satisfeito), fiz conversa.
ops.issue: Same error as lit_en: 心ゆく rendered as 'o coração se esvaziar' (empty itself). ゆく = ir/chegar à satisfação, not esvaziar; contradicts expl_pt ('o coração se contentar').

ops.current: te-form of する (した→して), joining 外出 to the auxiliary いる
ops.fix: Fix both locale strings: pt-BR 'forma て de する (する→して), unindo 外出 ao auxiliar いる'; en 'te-form of する (する→して), joining 外出 to the auxiliary いる'
ops.issue: Note derives the te-form with '(した→して)' — した is the past form, not the source of して. Should be '(する→して)' as in the parallel note of sent:tatoeba-82998. Same typo in both the en and pt-BR note strings.

ops.current: ははわいつもやできものをきている。

ops.current: hahawaitsumoyadekimonookiteiru.

ops.current: hahawa,nennowariniwawakakumiemasu.
ops.fix: hahawa,toshinowariniwawakakumiemasu.

ops.current: If Mom comes back, (I'll) get scolded. (emphasis)

ops.current: べいわあたたかいくにでできる。
ops.fix: こめわあたたかいくにでできる。

ops.fix: こめ

ops.current: I need to hear it.
ops.fix: I want to hear it.
ops.issue: 聞きたい expresses desire — exactly the 〜たい point the explanation teaches; 'need' misstates it as necessity and clashes with lit_en ('...who wants to hear it') and pt ('Eu quero ouvir isso').

ops.current: The stated target is かな ('I wonder if...?'), but it does NOT appear here: the sentence ends in くれ, an informal request, not in a question with かな.
ops.fix: Delete only the final sentence beginning 'The stated target is かな…'; keep the preceding 〜ないでくれ explanation unchanged.
ops.full_before: The sentence uses the negative request 〜ないでくれ, which means 'please don't do (something)'. We start from the verb 聞く ('to ask'), take its negative form 聞かない, link it with the particle で and close with くれ (the informal imperative form of くれる, 'to do a favor for me'). The stated target is かな ('I wonder if...?'), but it does NOT appear here: the sentence ends in くれ, an informal request, not in a question with かな.
ops.issue: Internal course metadata leaked into the learner-facing explanation: a note about a 'stated target かな' that does not occur in the sentence. Confusing for beginners and irrelevant to the 〜ないでくれ structure being explained; it also reveals a wrong grammar-target link.

ops.current: O alvo declarado é かな ('será que...?'), mas ele NÃO aparece aqui: a frase termina em くれ, um pedido informal, não numa pergunta com かな.
ops.fix: Remover apenas a frase final iniciada em 'O alvo declarado é かな…'; manter intacta a explicação de 〜ないでくれ.
ops.full_before: A frase usa o pedido negativo 〜ないでくれ, que significa 'por favor, não faça (algo)'. Partimos do verbo 聞く (perguntar), pegamos sua forma negativa 聞かない, ligamos com a partícula で e fechamos com くれ (forma imperativa informal de くれる, 'fazer um favor a mim'). O alvo declarado é かな ('será que...?'), mas ele NÃO aparece aqui: a frase termina em くれ, um pedido informal, não numa pergunta com かな.
ops.issue: Same internal target-mismatch note leaked into the pt explanation ('O alvo declarado é かな...'); it is not learner-facing content and confuses the actual 〜ないでくれ lesson.

ops.current: To take a class on literature.
ops.fix: Of literature, a lecture to do (= to give).
ops.issue: 講義をする means to GIVE/deliver a lecture; 'to take a class' reverses the participant role (attending vs teaching) and contradicts en ('I will lecture on literature') and expl_en ('to give a lecture').

ops.current: to do (nominalization of しよう, in the set phrase どうしようもない)
ops.fix: to do (the しよう of する in the set phrase どうしようもない, 'there's nothing that can be done')
ops.issue: 'nominalization of しよう' is circular (defines しよう as a nominalization of itself) and misidentifies the form: in どうしようもない, しよう is the volitional of する (どうしよう 'what could one do' + もない).

ops.current: fazer (nominalização de しよう, na expressão fixa どうしようもない)
ops.fix: fazer (o しよう de する na expressão fixa どうしようもない, 'não há nada que se possa fazer')
ops.issue: Same circular/garbled form label as the en gloss: 'nominalização de しよう' describes the token as a nominalization of itself; しよう here is the forma volitiva de する.

ops.current: Things like physics, I'm utterly hopeless at.
ops.fix: Things like physics — absolutely not (flatly refused).
ops.issue: まっぴらだ expresses flat refusal ('absolutely not / I want no part of it'), not inability. 'I'm utterly hopeless at' misreads it as being bad at physics, contradicting expl_en and lit_pt ('totalmente-recusada').

ops.current: As roupas eram vermelhas, rosas, azuis e assim por diante.
ops.fix: As roupas eram vermelhas, rosa, azuis e assim por diante.
ops.issue: In pt-BR the color adjective 'rosa' (noun-derived color) is invariable: 'as roupas eram rosa', never 'rosas'. Plural 'rosas' is an agreement error (and reads as the flower).

ops.current: weather vane, windsock
ops.fix: weather vane, weathercock
ops.issue: 風見 means (roof-mounted) weather vane/weathercock; a windsock is 吹き流し. 'windsock' is not a valid gloss for 風見 (JMdict: weather vane). The pt gloss correctly has only 'cata-vento'.

ops.current: Cortina de luz (sujeito) vaza.
ops.fix: Da cortina, luz (sujeito) vaza.

ops.current: I can't stand getting beaten.
ops.fix: I can't let myself become a loser.
ops.issue: en mistranslates the sentence: わけにはいかない expresses 'cannot afford to / must not (for moral-social reasons)', not emotional intolerance ('can't stand'), and 負け犬になる is 'become a loser', not 'getting beaten'. It contradicts lit_en, pt, and both expl fields, misteaching the target pattern.

ops.current: ちちじょう、なんをしておられるのか。
ops.fix: ちちうえ、なにをしておられるのか。

ops.current: chichijou,nanoshiteorarerunoka.
ops.fix: chichiue,nanioshiteorarerunoka.

ops.current: なん

ops.current: forma 〜て de したがる (したがう→したがって); したがる é o desiderativo de terceira pessoa de する + がる

ops.fix: chichiwaiedewananimoshimasen.

ops.current: Com adjetivos-な (formas estado) como 元気
ops.fix: Com adjetivos-な (formas de estado) como 元気

Com adjetivos-な (formas estado) como 元気 ('com saúde/disposição'), o padrão é 元気になる ('ficar saudável'), onde に é a forma adverbial de だ que conecta o adjetivo-な a なる. O advérbio まもなく ('em breve, logo') indica que isso ocorrerá em pouco tempo, e だろう ('deve, provavelmente') marca conjectura.

ops.current: Meu pai me insistiu para que eu fosse junto.
ops.fix: Meu pai insistiu para que eu fosse junto com ele.
ops.issue: 'Me insistiu' is ungrammatical in Brazilian Portuguese — insistir does not take a person as direct object (would be 'insistiu comigo'). せきたてた = apressou/instou fits better.

ops.current: なん
ops.fix: なに
ops.issue: Token 何 is given reading なん; as the pronoun 何(か) 'something' the standard reading is なに (なにか). なんか is a colloquial variant, misleading as the taught reading.

ops.current: followed by のので, which joins the nominalizer の with ので ('because/since'), expressing the reason
ops.fix: followed by ので ('because/since'), which joins the nominalizer の with で (the て-form of the copula), expressing the reason
ops.full_before: The sentence has two parts: the cause 病気な (the adnominal form of 病気だ, 'to be ill/sick') followed by のので, which joins the nominalizer の with ので ('because/since'), expressing the reason. The second part ご一緒できません is the humble and polite form of 一緒にできる ('to be able to be together'), negated with 〜ません. The honorific prefix ご raises the level of courtesy, typical of declining an invitation politely.
ops.issue: Wrong decomposition: text says 病気な is followed by 'のので, which joins the nominalizer の with ので'. The sentence contains ので, not のので; ので itself = nominalizer の + で (te-form of the copula). As written it teaches a false form (病気なのので) and a circular analysis.

ops.current: seguida de のので, que junta o nominalizador の com ので ('porque/já que'), exprimindo o motivo
ops.fix: seguida de ので ('porque/já que'), que junta o nominalizador の com で (forma て da cópula), exprimindo o motivo
ops.full_before: A frase tem duas partes: a causa 病気な (forma adnominal de 病気だ, 'ser doença/estar doente') seguida de のので, que junta o nominalizador の com ので ('porque/já que'), exprimindo o motivo. A segunda parte ご一緒できません é a forma humilde e educada de 一緒にできる ('poder estar junto'), negada com 〜ません. O prefixo honorífico ご eleva o tom de cortesia, típico de recusar um convite com polidez.
ops.issue: Same defect as expl_en: 'seguida de のので, que junta o nominalizador の com ので' — the sentence has ので, not のので; ので decompõe-se em の + で (forma て de だ). Teaches a false segmentation.

ops.fix: びょういんまでじゅうまいるもある。

ops.current: いちれい
ops.fix: じゅう
ops.issue: Token １０ has reading いちれい (digit-by-digit machine artifact); the correct reading of 10 here is じゅう.

ops.current: byouinmadeichireimairumoaru.
ops.fix: byouinmadejuumairumoaru.

ops.fix: おもて

ops.current: the verb 済ます ('to finish, get done with') in the polite interrogative form 済ませますか
ops.fix: the verb 済ませる ('to finish, to get done with') in the polite interrogative form 済ませますか
ops.full_before: Sentence with the object 用事 ('errand, task') marked by を and the verb 済ます ('to finish, get done with') in the polite interrogative form 済ませますか ('shall we finish?/shall we get it done?'). The adverb さあっと ('in an instant, quickly') at the start describes how the action will be done, and the と here is the adverbial と that accompanies onomatopoeia/adverbs of manner. The question is a gentle invitation to do something.
ops.issue: Wrong verb/conjugation ID: 済ませます is the polite form of ichidan 済ませる, not of godan 済ます (whose polite form is 済まします). The 済ま token note repeats the error, calling 済ま the 連用形 of 済ます (it is the mizenkei of 済む + せ, i.e. lexical 済ませる).

ops.current: o verbo 済ます ('terminar, dar conta de') na forma educada interrogativa 済ませますか
ops.fix: o verbo 済ませる ('terminar, dar conta de') na forma educada interrogativa 済ませますか
ops.full_before: Frase com objeto 用事 ('afazer, tarefa') marcado por を e o verbo 済ます ('terminar, dar conta de') na forma educada interrogativa 済ませますか ('vamos terminar?/terminamos?'). O advérbio さあっと ('num instante, rapidinho') no início descreve como a ação será feita, e o と aqui é o と adverbial que acompanha onomatopeias/advérbios de modo. A pergunta é um convite suave a fazer algo.
ops.issue: Same wrong conjugation claim in the pt explanation: 済ませますか is a form of 済ませる (ichidan), not of 済ます (godan; its polite form would be 済まします).

ops.current: Coverage de N5: へ de direção + のほう ('na direção de') + 〜ていく (movimento que se afasta).
ops.fix: Cobertura N5: へ de direção + のほう ('na direção de') + 〜ていく (movimento que se afasta).
ops.full_before: Sujeito 飛行機 ('avião') marcado por が. O destino/direção é 西のほう ('o lado oeste / a direção oeste'), em que の liga 西 a ほう ('lado/direção'), e へ marca para onde se vai. O verbo aparece como composto 飛んでいった: forma て de 飛ぶ ('voar') + いく ('ir') no passado, dando a ideia de afastar-se voando. Coverage de N5: へ de direção + のほう ('na direção de') + 〜ていく (movimento que se afasta).
ops.issue: English course-design jargon left untranslated in learner-facing pt-BR text: 'Coverage de N5'. Should be Portuguese wording (e.g. 'Conteúdo de N5').

ops.current: Hoje, quanto a cantar, não quero, é que... mas

ops.current: なんをかってきてほしいの?
ops.fix: なにをかってきてほしいの?
ops.issue: 何 before the particle を is read なに, not なん (なん appears only before だ/の/で/counters). The kana transcribes 何を as なんを, teaching a wrong reading.

ops.fix: なに
ops.issue: Token reading for 何 is なん, but before を the standard reading is なに.

ops.current: nanokattekitehoshiino?

ops.current: Vou decidir manter ela a distância por um tempo, viu.
ops.fix: Vou manter ela a distância por um tempo, viu.
ops.issue: 'Vou decidir manter' places the deciding in the future, but ことにする announces a decision made at speech time; no Brazilian would phrase it this way. Misleading for the very pattern (〜ことにする) being taught.

ops.current: There is a person (subj.) (I) want to meet (explanatory).

ops.current: Note that いっぱい appears as 'a lot,' not as the suffix ～っぱい.

ops.full_before: A casual existential sentence: [adverb of quantity] + ある + なぁ. いっぱい here is an adverb meaning 'a lot / a ton,' modifying ある ('to exist/have,' for inanimate things). なぁ at the end is an expressive particle giving a tone of admiration or musing to oneself. ops.issue: There is no suffix ～っぱい in Japanese; the intended contrast is with the homophone 一杯 (counter 杯, 'one cupful'). As written it invents a nonexistent morpheme.
